title: Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents
title_zh: 分享承载AI病毒：内存跳跃攻击跨LLM代理

paragraphs.en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as stateful assistants that retain information across interactions and use tools to read, modify, and create persistent artifacts. As these artifacts are shared between users, they form an indirect communication channel between otherwise independent assistants. We study a failure mode in which this channel enables self-propagating attacks. We introduce artifact-mediated propagation, where adversarial content introduced through an artifact (e.g. a report), is stored in an assistant’s persistent memory, reproduced in a subsequently created artifact, and acquired by another assistant that later reads it. We evaluate this process in temporal human–agent universes that model artifact exchange between independently operated assistants over time, measuring whether an attack survives successive hand-offs, how many hops it reaches, and how broadly it spreads. We find that attacks can propagate across multiple independent assistants and persist over extended interaction sequences. In larger simulated environments, even GPT-5.6 Luna exhibits substantial spread, reaching 60–80% of agents with propagation chains extending to eight hops. These results show that persistent artifacts can act as durable carriers of adversarial state, allowing attacks to outlive individual interactions and spread across isolated assistants.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被部署为具有状态记忆的助手，它们能在多次交互中保留信息，并利用工具读取、修改和创建持久性产物。 由于这些产物在用户之间共享，它们便在原本相互独立的助手之间形成了一条间接的通信渠道。 我们研究了一种故障模式：这种通信渠道会促成自我传播的攻击。 我们提出了“产物介导传播”的概念：通过某种产物（例如一份报告）引入的对抗性内容，会被存储到助手的持久性记忆中，随后在新生成的产物中重现，并最终被另一个读取该产物的助手获取。 我们在时间维度上模拟的人类-智能体环境中评估了这一过程，这些环境模型了独立运行的助手之间随时间发生的产物交换，并测量攻击能否在多次传递后存活、能传播多少步以及传播范围有多广。 我们发现，攻击可以在多个独立的助手之间传播，并在较长的交互序列中持续存在。 在更大的模拟环境中，即使是 GPT-5.6 Luna 也表现出显著传播，其传播链可达八步，影响范围覆盖 60%–80% 的智能体。 这些结果表明，持久性产物可以成为对抗性状态的稳定载体，使攻击能够超越单次交互而持续存在，并在相互隔离的助手之间扩散。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly incorporate persistent memory mechanisms that allow information to carry across otherwise separate interactions ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . At the same time, assistants increasingly operate over persistent artifacts: users ask them to read reports, summarize notes and create files for other people. Recently launched consumer products such as Grok Bot ( SpaceXAI, 2026 ) and Muse ( Meta, 2026a ) combine both properties: always-on personal agents that persist across sessions, reading and writing files on their users’ behalf. These two forms of persistence—memory inside the assistant and artifacts outside it—create an indirect channel between otherwise isolated assistants.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）助手越来越多地引入了持久化记忆机制，使信息能够在原本相互独立的交互中延续（Packer 等，2023；Zhong 等，2024；Wu 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025b）。 与此同时，助手越来越多地处理持久化产物：用户会要求它们阅读报告、总结笔记以及为他人创建文件。 最近推出的消费级产品，如 Grok Bot（SpaceXAI，2026）和 Muse（Meta，2026a），结合了这两种特性：始终在线的个人智能体能够跨会话持续运行，并代表用户读写文件。 这两种持久化形式——助手内部的记忆和助手外部的产物——在原本相互隔离的助手之间建立了一条间接通道。

sents.en: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly incorporate persistent memory mechanisms that allow information to carry across otherwise separate interactions ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) .

sents.en: Recently launched consumer products such as Grok Bot ( SpaceXAI, 2026 ) and Muse ( Meta, 2026a ) combine both properties: always-on personal agents that persist across sessions, reading and writing files on their users’ behalf.
sents.zh: 最近推出的消费级产品，如 Grok Bot（SpaceXAI，2026）和 Muse（Meta，2026a），结合了这两种特性：始终在线的个人智能体能够跨会话持续运行，并代表用户读写文件。

sents.en: These two forms of persistence—memory inside the assistant and artifacts outside it—create an indirect channel between otherwise isolated assistants.
sents.zh: 这两种持久化形式——助手内部的记忆和助手外部的产物——在原本相互隔离的助手之间建立了一条间接通道。

paragraphs.en: Persistent memory already creates a ‘delayed adversarial surface’: information encountered during one task can be incorporated into an assistant’s memory and influence unrelated tasks much later ( Pulipaka et al., 2026 ; Gadgil et al., 2026 ; Dash et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) . Existing work has largely studied this persistence of a malicious artifact in memory, and how that state later changes the behavior of the same assistant. We study what happens when this effect extends beyond a single agent. If a compromised assistant later reproduces the adversarial state into an artifact it creates, and that artifact is subsequently consumed by another independently operated assistant, the attack can propagate across agents without direct communication. We call this artifact-mediated propagation .
paragraphs.zh: 持久性记忆已经形成了一种“延迟对抗表面”：在一次任务中接触到的信息可以被整合到助手的记忆中，并在很久之后影响不相关的任务（Pulipaka 等人，2026；Gadgil 等人，2026；Dash 等人，2026；Zou 等人，2026）。 现有研究主要探讨了恶意残留物在记忆中的这种持久性，以及该状态后来如何改变同一助手的行为。 我们研究了当这种效应扩展到单个智能体之外时会发生什么。 如果一个被入侵的助手后来将对抗状态复制到其生成的某个产物中，而该产物随后被另一个独立运行的助手使用，那么攻击便可以在没有直接通信的情况下在多个智能体之间传播。 我们将这种通过产物媒介的传播称为“产物介导传播”。

sents.en: Persistent memory already creates a ‘delayed adversarial surface’: information encountered during one task can be incorporated into an assistant’s memory and influence unrelated tasks much later ( Pulipaka et al., 2026 ; Gadgil et al., 2026 ; Dash et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 持久性记忆已经形成了一种“延迟对抗表面”：在一次任务中接触到的信息可以被整合到助手的记忆中，并在很久之后影响不相关的任务（Pulipaka 等人，2026；Gadgil 等人，2026；Dash 等人，2026；Zou 等人，2026）。

sents.zh: 现有研究主要探讨了恶意残留物在记忆中的这种持久性，以及该状态后来如何改变同一助手的行为。

sents.en: We study what happens when this effect extends beyond a single agent.
sents.zh: 我们研究了当这种效应扩展到单个智能体之外时会发生什么。

sents.en: If a compromised assistant later reproduces the adversarial state into an artifact it creates, and that artifact is subsequently consumed by another independently operated assistant, the attack can propagate across agents without direct communication.
sents.zh: 如果一个被入侵的助手后来将对抗状态复制到其生成的某个产物中，而该产物随后被另一个独立运行的助手使用，那么攻击便可以在没有直接通信的情况下在多个智能体之间传播。

sents.en: We call this artifact-mediated propagation .
sents.zh: 我们将这种通过产物媒介的传播称为“产物介导传播”。

paragraphs.en: Self-propagating behavior in LLM systems has been demonstrated in several settings, including direct model-to-model interaction ( Lee & Tiwari, 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) , RAG-enabled email ecosystems ( Cohen et al., 2025 ) , autonomous multi-agent communication and persistent carriers ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zha & Wang, 2026 ) , shared collaborative state ( Patlan et al., 2025 ) , and reusable coding-agent resources ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . A common feature of these settings is that propagation occurs through a communication or state-sharing substrate available to the agents themselves, such as direct messaging, shared memory, automatically indexed content, or persistent agent resources. We study a different regime: assistants are independently operated as personal assistants to user, where they maintain private memory, and have no direct communication channel with other agents. The only connection between them arises when their users exchange ordinary artifacts and independently ask their assistants to read or write those artifacts as part of normal workflows. Thus, propagation is not driven by an autonomous agent network, but by adversarial state surviving a sequence of human-mediated artifact transfers across otherwise isolated assistants.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型系统中的自我传播行为已在多种场景中得到验证，包括模型间的直接交互（Lee & Tiwari, 2024；Yu et al., 2024）、支持检索增强生成（RAG）的电子邮件生态系统（Cohen et al., 2025）、自主的多智能体通信与持久化载体（Zhang et al., 2026b；Zha & Wang, 2026）、共享协作状态（Patlan et al., 2025），以及可重用的编码智能体资源（Wu et al., 2026）。 这些场景的共同特征是，传播通过智能体自身可用的通信或状态共享媒介实现，例如直接消息传递、共享内存、自动索引的内容或持久化的智能体资源。 我们研究一种不同的模式：助手作为用户的个人助理独立运行，它们维护私有记忆，且与其他智能体之间没有直接的通信渠道。 它们之间的唯一联系出现在用户交换普通工件，并各自独立地要求自己的助手在正常工作流程中读取或写入这些工件时。 因此，传播并非由自主的智能体网络驱动，而是由对抗性状态在一系列经由人类中介的、跨原本相互隔离的助手的工件传输过程中得以延续所驱动。

sents.en: Self-propagating behavior in LLM systems has been demonstrated in several settings, including direct model-to-model interaction ( Lee & Tiwari, 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) , RAG-enabled email ecosystems ( Cohen et al., 2025 ) , autonomous multi-agent communication and persistent carriers ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zha & Wang, 2026 ) , shared collaborative state ( Patlan et al., 2025 ) , and reusable coding-agent resources ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .

sents.zh: 它们之间的唯一联系出现在用户交换普通工件，并各自独立地要求自己的助手在正常工作流程中读取或写入这些工件时。

sents.zh: 因此，传播并非由自主的智能体网络驱动，而是由对抗性状态在一系列经由人类中介的、跨原本相互隔离的助手的工件传输过程中得以延续所驱动。

paragraphs.en: We study whether a single poisoned seed artifact can cause adversarial state to propagate across multiple independently operated assistants. The adversary begins with no access to any assistant’s private memory and no control over the future agents, users, or tasks that the attack may encounter. It controls one seed artifact processed by one assistant and, in the endpoint-assisted variant, operates an external service that can modify artifacts sent to it. For propagation to continue, the adversarial state must first survive in that assistant’s persistent memory. It must then influence a later, unrelated writing task strongly enough that the assistant places a viable copy of the attack into a new artifact. That artifact must subsequently be read by another clean assistant, which then recreates the same state. This artifact–memory–artifact cycle must then repeat, and it stops wherever an assistant fails to retain the attack or to reproduce it in what it writes. This is harder than causing a single malicious action. We consider two variants: an endpoint-assisted attack, which our main experiments evaluate, in which the assistant routes the artifacts it writes through the attacker’s service, which reinserts a clean copy of the attack, so the assistant need only preserve a short carry-forward instruction (Section 4.1 ); and a prompt-only attack, in which the assistant carries and reproduces the attack from memory alone (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究单个被污染的种子工件是否会导致对抗性状态在多个独立运行的助手之间传播。 攻击者最初无法访问任何助手的私有记忆，也无法控制未来智能体、用户或攻击可能遇到的任务。 攻击者控制着一个由某个助手处理的种子工件，并且在端点辅助变体中，还能操作一个能够修改传入工件的外部服务。 要实现持续传播，对抗性状态必须首先在该助手的持久化记忆中存活下来。 接着，它必须对后续一个无关的写作任务产生足够强的影响，使得助手将攻击的一个有效副本写入一个新的工件。 随后，该工件必须被另一个干净的助手读取，而该助手则会重新生成相同的状态。 这种“工件–记忆–工件”循环必须持续重复，直到某个助手未能保留攻击内容或未能将其写入输出时才会停止。 这比引发单次恶意行为更为困难。 我们考虑两种变体：端点辅助攻击（我们的主要实验对此进行了评估），即助手将其生成的工件通过攻击者的服务传输，该服务会重新植入攻击的干净副本，因此助手只需保留一段简短的延续指令（第 4.1 节）；以及仅提示攻击，即助手完全依靠记忆携带并重现攻击内容（附录 D）。

sents.zh: 我们研究单个被污染的种子工件是否会导致对抗性状态在多个独立运行的助手之间传播。

sents.en: We consider two variants: an endpoint-assisted attack, which our main experiments evaluate, in which the assistant routes the artifacts it writes through the attacker’s service, which reinserts a clean copy of the attack, so the assistant need only preserve a short carry-forward instruction (Section 4.1 ); and a prompt-only attack, in which the assistant carries and reproduces the attack from memory alone (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 我们考虑两种变体：端点辅助攻击（我们的主要实验对此进行了评估），即助手将其生成的工件通过攻击者的服务传输，该服务会重新植入攻击的干净副本，因此助手只需保留一段简短的延续指令（第 4.1 节）；以及仅提示攻击，即助手完全依靠记忆携带并重现攻击内容（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: To study this phenomenon, we introduce temporal human–agent universes : simulated workflows in which users repeatedly ask their personal assistants to read, write, and edit artifacts exchanged between users over time. For each target model, we optimize a single goal-agnostic attack template on development universes, freeze it, and evaluate it on unseen adversarial goals and universes. Our main experiments show that the endpoint-assisted attack can spread across many independently operated assistants over successive hand-offs, with no direct communication between them.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究这一现象，我们引入了时间维度下的人类-智能体宇宙：即模拟工作流程，其中用户反复要求他们的个人助理读取、编写和编辑用户之间随时间交换的成果。 对于每个目标模型，我们在开发宇宙中优化一个单一且与目标无关的攻击模板，然后将其固定，并在未见的对抗性目标和宇宙中进行评估。 我们的主要实验表明，这种终端辅助攻击可以在连续交接过程中传播到许多独立运行的助理之间，而它们之间无需直接通信。

sents.en: To study this phenomenon, we introduce temporal human–agent universes : simulated workflows in which users repeatedly ask their personal assistants to read, write, and edit artifacts exchanged between users over time.
sents.zh: 为了研究这一现象，我们引入了时间维度下的人类-智能体宇宙：即模拟工作流程，其中用户反复要求他们的个人助理读取、编写和编辑用户之间随时间交换的成果。

sents.en: For each target model, we optimize a single goal-agnostic attack template on development universes, freeze it, and evaluate it on unseen adversarial goals and universes.
sents.zh: 对于每个目标模型，我们在开发宇宙中优化一个单一且与目标无关的攻击模板，然后将其固定，并在未见的对抗性目标和宇宙中进行评估。

sents.en: Our main experiments show that the endpoint-assisted attack can spread across many independently operated assistants over successive hand-offs, with no direct communication between them.
sents.zh: 我们的主要实验表明，这种终端辅助攻击可以在连续交接过程中传播到许多独立运行的助理之间，而它们之间无需直接通信。

paragraphs.en: Indirect prompt injection exploits the inability of language-model applications to reliably separate trusted instructions from untrusted external content ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) . Bad Memory studies memory injections in agentic systems based on Claude Code and OpenAI Codex ( Gadgil et al., 2026 ) , while benchmarks such as InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , Agent Security Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and WASP ( Evtimov et al., 2025 ) evaluate whether malicious tool outputs can redirect an agent’s current task or tool use. These works target single-agent compromise rather than a propagation process in which malicious state persists across sessions, is reproduced into a new artifact, and subsequently infects another independently operated assistant.
paragraphs.zh: 间接提示注入利用了语言模型应用无法可靠地区分可信指令与不可信外部内容的缺陷（Greshake 等人，2023）。 Bad Memory 研究基于 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex 的智能体系统中的内存注入问题（Gadgil 等人，2026），而 InjecAgent（Zhan 等人，2024）、AgentDojo（Debenedetti 等人，2024）、Agent Security Bench（Zhang 等人，2025a）和 WASP（Evtimov 等人，2025）等基准测试则评估恶意工具输出是否能够改变智能体的当前任务或工具使用方式。 这些研究针对的是单个智能体被攻破的情况，而非一种传播过程：在此过程中，恶意状态会跨会话持续存在、被复制到新的产物中，并随后感染另一个独立运行的助手。

paragraphs.en: Persistent memory poisoning and cross-user contamination. Hidden in Memory studies sleeper memory poisoning, where an adversarial document causes a fabricated memory to be written and later used in separate conversations ( Pulipaka et al., 2026 ) . Other work develops benchmarks and taxonomies for memory-write vulnerabilities ( Dash et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) or demonstrates cross-session compromise from malicious content encountered by agents ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Das et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . MemoryGraft, MINJA, and InjecMEM poison stored experiences or memory records that influence later tasks ( Srivastava & He, 2025 ; Dong et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ) . These studies examine persistence and later behavior, but not repeated transmission through new artifacts between independent assistants. MURMUR studies poisoning across users interacting with a shared collaborative agent and persistent state ( Patlan et al., 2025 ) ; unintentional cross-user contamination has also been studied in shared-state agents ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . Our setting differs from these shared-state settings: each user has an independent assistant with private memory, and compromise moves between assistants only through artifacts their users create and consume. Our setting differs from both: each user has an independent assistant with private memory, and compromise moves between assistants only through artifacts their users create and consume.
paragraphs.zh: 持久性记忆中毒与跨用户污染。 “Hidden in Memory”研究探讨了潜伏记忆中毒现象，即恶意文档会导致虚假记忆被写入，并在后续不同对话中被使用（Pulipaka 等，2026）。 其他研究为记忆写入漏洞开发了基准和分类体系（Dash 等，2026；Gao 等，2026；Chen 等，2026；Xie 等，2026），或展示了智能体遭遇恶意内容后引发的跨会话安全漏洞（Zou 等，2026；Das 等，2026；Yang 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026a）。 MemoryGraft、MINJA 和 InjecMEM 会污染存储的体验或记忆记录，从而影响后续任务（Srivastava & He，2025；Dong 等，2026；Tian 等，2026）。 这些研究考察了记忆的持久性及其后续行为，但未涉及通过新产物在独立智能体之间的重复传播。 MURMUR 研究了共享协作智能体及持久状态中用户间交互引发的中毒现象（Patlan 等，2025）；共享状态智能体中的非故意跨用户污染也已被研究（Yang 等，2026a）。 我们的设定与这些共享状态场景不同：每个用户拥有独立且具备私有记忆的智能体，而安全漏洞仅在智能体通过其用户创建和使用的产物之间传递。 我们的设定与上述两种场景均不同：每个用户拥有独立且具备私有记忆的智能体，而安全漏洞仅在智能体通过其用户创建和使用的产物之间传递。

paragraphs.en: Self-propagating attacks in agent ecosystems. Prompt Infection demonstrates propagation through direct LLM-to-LLM communication in connected multi-agent systems ( Lee & Tiwari, 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) . The AI Worm spreads self-replicating prompts through RAG-enabled email assistants whose incoming correspondence is automatically indexed and later retrieved during outgoing email generation ( Cohen et al., 2025 ) . AgentWorm studies persistent multi-hop propagation through group messages, configuration-file modification, and agent-to-agent transmission ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while Autonomous LLM Agent Worms studies file-backed carriers, scheduled re-entry, semantic degradation, and cross-platform transmission through shared messaging surfaces ( Zha & Wang, 2026 ) . Mind Viruses evolves ideas and action payloads that spread through direct interactions in coding-agent teams and stylized agent chains ( Papadopoulos et al., 2026 ) , and ( Wu et al., 2026 ) studies poisoning through coding agents’ skill files; its social-post extension tests an artifact-mediated cycle but does not obtain second-hop propagation. In contrast, we study propagation through ordinary human-authorized read and write tasks, without direct inter-agent messaging, shared memory, peer discovery, or autonomous messaging loops.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体生态系统中的自我传播攻击。 “提示感染”展示了在互联的多智能体系统中，通过 LLM 与 LLM 的直接通信实现传播（Lee & Tiwari, 2024；Yu et al., 2024）。 “AI 蠕虫”通过启用 RAG 的邮件助手传播自我复制的提示；这些助手的收件内容会被自动索引，并在后续生成发送邮件时被检索使用（Cohen et al., 2025）。 “AgentWorm”研究了通过群聊消息、配置文件修改以及智能体间传输实现的持久多跳传播（Zhang et al., 2026b）；而“自主 LLM 智能体蠕虫”则研究了以文件为载体的传播方式，包括定时重新接入、语义退化以及通过共享消息接口实现跨平台传输（Zha & Wang, 2026）。 “思维病毒”会演化思想和行动载荷，这些载荷通过编码智能体团队和结构化智能体链中的直接互动进行传播（Papadopoulos et al., 2026）；而（Wu et al., 2026）则研究了通过编码智能体的技能文件实现的中毒机制；其社交发帖扩展测试了一种由人工制品中介的传播循环，但未实现第二跳传播。 相比之下，我们研究的是通过普通人类授权的读写任务实现的传播，其中不存在智能体间的直接通信、共享内存、同辈发现或自主消息循环。

paragraphs.en: Goal-agnostic propagation. Hidden in Memory is the closest prior work on attack generality: it optimizes one reusable memory-poisoning template across many adversarial goals and unseen documents ( Pulipaka et al., 2026 ) , but does not require that template to reproduce through new artifacts or remain infectious across multiple agents. Propagation work more commonly constructs or optimizes attacks for particular malicious effects. Mind Viruses, for example, evolves a distinct seed for each ideology or action ( Papadopoulos et al., 2026 ) , while the AI Worm and AgentWorm separate replication from the malicious action but evaluate only a small set of predefined payloads ( Cohen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Prior propagation studies therefore do not evaluate one frozen natural-language template across a large held-out set of adversarial goals and human workflows. We instead optimize the shared parameters of a goal-parameterized template P ϕ ​ ( g ) P_{\phi}(g) on development universes, freeze the template, and evaluate it on previously unseen goals, artifacts, and task sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 目标无关的传播。 《Hidden in Memory》是有关攻击通用性的最相关先验研究：它在多个对抗性目标和未见过的文档中优化一个可重复使用的记忆中毒模板（Pulipaka 等，2026），但该模板无需通过新产物进行自我复制，也无需在多个智能体之间保持传染性。 传播相关的研究通常是为特定的恶意效果构建或优化攻击。 例如，《Mind Viruses》为每种意识形态或行动演化一个独特的种子（Papadopoulos 等，2026），而《AI Worm》和《AgentWorm》则将复制与恶意行为分离，但仅评估一组预定义的负载（Cohen 等，2025；Zhang 等，2026b）。 因此，先前的传播研究并未在一个大型预留的对抗性目标和人类工作流程集合中评估一个固定的自然语言模板。 我们则相反，在开发宇宙中对一个以目标为参数的模板 P_φ(g) 的共享参数进行优化，然后冻结该模板，并在之前未见过的新目标、新产物和新任务序列上对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: People often use personal AI assistants to do tasks such as reading artifacts (e.g. pdf documents, code, excel files) and creating new ones that other users’ AI assistants then consume. For example, Alice may ask her assistant to summarize a report and later use that report to draft a handoff document that Bob’s assistant reads. The agents never communicate; each acts only on tasks from its own user. We call settings where human workflows determine when agents act and what they read or write human–agent universes .
paragraphs.zh: 人们经常使用个人人工智能助手来执行任务，例如阅读各种资料（如 PDF 文档、代码和 Excel 文件），以及创建新的资料，供其他用户的人工智能助手进一步使用。 例如，爱丽丝可能会要求她的人工智能助手对一份报告进行摘要，随后利用这份报告起草一份交接文档，由鲍勃的人工智能助手阅读。 这些智能体之间从不交流；每个智能体仅根据自己用户的指令执行任务。 我们将那些由人类工作流程决定智能体何时行动以及它们读取或生成什么内容的环境，称为“人类–智能体宇宙”。

paragraphs.en: At simulation time t t , agent a a has a private workspace 𝒲 t a \mathcal{W}^{a}_{t} and persistent memory ℳ t a \mathcal{M}^{a}_{t} . Other agents cannot inspect either, and there is no direct communication channel or shared memory store. Event e i e_{i} occurs at time τ i \tau_{i} and specifies an agent, its input artifacts, or an output artifact target if applicable, and a natural-language user request to read , write , or edit . Events execute in index order, with τ i ≤ τ i + 1 \tau_{i}\leq\tau_{i+1} ; the index also orders events that share a time step. The sequence fixes the tasks and artifact consumption/creation, while the agents determine their responses and the resulting artifact contents. The workflow forms a temporal bipartite graph of agents and artifacts. A read edge points from the version of an artifact available at event e i e_{i} to the acting agent; a write or edit edge points from that agent to the version it produces. Thus, a path through Alice and Bob may take the form d report ⟶ a Alice ⟶ d handoff ⟶ a Bob d_{\mathrm{report}}\longrightarrow a_{\mathrm{Alice}}\longrightarrow d_{\mathrm{handoff}}\longrightarrow a_{\mathrm{Bob}} .

paragraphs.en: The attacker aims to make an adversarial goal spread from one assistant to others through the artifacts they read and write. Let g g be that goal, and let ϕ \phi be the goal-agnostic instructions in an attack prompt for remembering and passing it on. We write the resulting attack prompt as P ϕ ​ ( g ) P_{\phi}(g) . For example, g g might be to promote a particular political agenda in future artifacts, while ϕ \phi instructs an assistant to remember that message and include both the message and the propagation instructions in any future artifacts it creates. The attacker inserts this prompt into one benign artifact to create the poisoned seed:

paragraphs.en: Initially, all agent memories and all other artifacts are clean with no adversarial prompt injection. The attacker cannot access agents’ private memories or choose the users’ later tasks. We allow the attacker to operate an external service that can modify an artifact if an agent sends it there, but the attacker cannot directly edit artifacts in agents’ workspaces. For the attack to propagate, an agent reading the seed must retain g g and a way to carry it forward. During a later user-requested writing task, it must produce an artifact that causes another agent to retain the same goal and propagation instructions. Repeating this artifact–memory–artifact cycle spreads the attack across agents. An agent that reads the original seed directly has been exposed to the seed, rather than infected through an artifact produced by another agent.
paragraphs.zh: 最初，所有智能体的记忆以及所有其他工件都是干净的，没有恶意提示注入。 攻击者无法访问智能体的私有记忆，也无法选择用户后续的任务。 我们允许攻击者运行一个外部服务，如果智能体将某个工件发送到该服务，攻击者就可以修改它，但攻击者不能直接编辑智能体工作区中的工件。 要使攻击传播，读取种子的智能体必须保留 g g，并具备将其传递下去的方法。 在用户后续请求的写作任务中，它必须生成一个工件，使另一个智能体保留相同的目标和传播指令。 重复这种“工件–记忆–工件”的循环，就能将攻击扩散到多个智能体之间。 直接读取原始种子的智能体是接触到了种子，而不是通过另一个智能体生成的工件而受到感染。

paragraphs.en: We optimize the goal-agnostic instructions, ϕ \phi using development universes and goals, then freeze it. At test time, goals, artifacts, personas, and task sequences are unseen while ϕ \phi remains fixed. We call the attack universal because the same instructions are intended to work with different adversarial goals without being redesigned for each one.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用开发宇宙和目标来优化与目标无关的指令 ϕ \phi，然后将其固定。 在测试阶段，目标、产物、角色和任务序列都是未见的，而 ϕ \phi 保持固定不变。 我们将这种攻击称为通用攻击，因为相同的指令旨在与不同的对抗性目标配合使用，而无需为每个目标重新设计。

sents.en: We optimize the goal-agnostic instructions, ϕ \phi using development universes and goals, then freeze it.
sents.zh: 我们利用开发宇宙和目标来优化与目标无关的指令 ϕ \phi，然后将其固定。

sents.en: At test time, goals, artifacts, personas, and task sequences are unseen while ϕ \phi remains fixed.
sents.zh: 在测试阶段，目标、产物、角色和任务序列都是未见的，而 ϕ \phi 保持固定不变。

sents.en: We call the attack universal because the same instructions are intended to work with different adversarial goals without being redesigned for each one.
sents.zh: 我们将这种攻击称为通用攻击，因为相同的指令旨在与不同的对抗性目标配合使用，而无需为每个目标重新设计。

paragraphs.en: The attack prompt must survive repeated artifact–memory–artifact cycles (Section 3.2 ). The most direct way to achieve this is for each infected agent to remember the full attack prompt and reproduce it in the artifacts it later creates. This is lossy: agents summarize, paraphrase, or omit parts of the prompt when storing it in memory and when writing into the next artifact, so the attack degrades with every hop (Appendix D ). We therefore use endpoint-assisted propagation , in which the attack prompt encourages an agent to use an external endpoint to help it create any new artifacts, which is designed by the adversary to include the full attack prompt in any new artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 攻击提示必须能够经受反复的“工件–记忆–工件”循环（第 3.2 节）。 实现这一目标最直接的方法，是让每个被感染的智能体记住完整的攻击提示，并在其后续创建的工件中重新生成该提示。 这种方法存在信息损失：智能体在将提示存储到记忆中以及写入下一个工件时，会对提示进行总结、改写或省略部分内容，因此攻击效果会随着每次传递而减弱（附录 D）。 因此，我们采用端点辅助传播方法：攻击提示会引导智能体使用外部端点来协助创建任何新工件，而该端点由攻击者设计，以确保任何新工件都包含完整的攻击提示。

sents.en: The attack prompt must survive repeated artifact–memory–artifact cycles (Section 3.2 ).
sents.zh: 攻击提示必须能够经受反复的“工件–记忆–工件”循环（第 3.2 节）。

sents.en: We therefore use endpoint-assisted propagation , in which the attack prompt encourages an agent to use an external endpoint to help it create any new artifacts, which is designed by the adversary to include the full attack prompt in any new artifact.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用端点辅助传播方法：攻击提示会引导智能体使用外部端点来协助创建任何新工件，而该端点由攻击者设计，以确保任何新工件都包含完整的攻击提示。

paragraphs.en: In endpoint-assisted propagation, the attack prompt P ϕ ​ ( g ) P_{\phi}(g) contains the instructions ϕ \phi to remember that every artifact the agent later creates should be passed through an external endpoint before it is saved or shared. The endpoint is configured beforehand by the adversary to align with the adversarial goal g g . When an agent calls it, the endpoint receives the artifact, inserts a canonical copy of the attack prompt, and returns the modified artifact, Endpoint ​ ( d ′ ) = Insert ​ ( d ′ , P ϕ ​ ( g ) ) \texttt{Endpoint}(d^{\prime})=\texttt{Insert}\left(d^{\prime},P_{\phi}(g)\right) . A successful transmission therefore follows P ϕ ​ ( g ) ⟶ ℳ a ⟶ Endpoint ​ ( d ′ ) ⟶ ℳ b P_{\phi}(g)\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{a}\longrightarrow\texttt{Endpoint}(d^{\prime})\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{b} , where ℳ a \mathcal{M}^{a} and ℳ b \mathcal{M}^{b} are the private memories of successive agents and d ′ d^{\prime} is an artifact created during an ordinary user-requested task. The agent must preserve only the goal, the instruction to store in memory and the instruction to use the endpoint; it does not need to reconstruct the attack prompt, and each successful endpoint call places a fresh, uncorrupted copy of the attack prompt into the next artifact. Propagation can still fail: an agent may store the goal but drop the instruction, or retain the instruction but not call the endpoint during a later writing task. The mechanism requires outbound network access and permission to send artifacts to an external service.
paragraphs.zh: 在端点辅助传播中，攻击提示 P ϕ ​ ( g ) P_{\phi}(g) 包含指令 ϕ \phi，要求智能体记住：其后续创建的每个产物都必须在保存或共享之前通过外部端点处理。 该端点由攻击者预先配置，以与对抗目标 g g 保持一致。 当智能体调用端点时，端点会接收该产物、插入攻击提示的标准副本，并返回修改后的产物：Endpoint ​ ( d ′ ) = Insert ​ ( d ′ , P ϕ ​ ( g ) ) \texttt{Endpoint}(d^{\prime})=\texttt{Insert}\left(d^{\prime},P_{\phi}(g)\right) 。 因此，一次成功的传播过程为：P ϕ ​ ( g ) ⟶ ℳ a ⟶ Endpoint ​ ( d ′ ) ⟶ ℳ b P_{\phi}(g)\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{a}\longrightarrow\texttt{Endpoint}(d^{\prime})\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{b}，其中 ℳ a \mathcal{M}^{a} 和 ℳ b \mathcal{M}^{b} 是连续智能体的私有记忆，而 d ′ d^{\prime} 是在普通用户请求任务中创建的产物。 智能体只需保留目标、存储指令以及使用端点的指令；它无需重构攻击提示，且每次成功的端点调用都会将攻击提示的一个全新、未损坏的副本写入下一个产物。 传播仍可能失败：智能体可能只存储了目标却遗漏了相关指令，或保留了指令但在后续写作任务中未调用端点。 该机制需要出站网络访问权限，以及向外部服务发送产物的权限。

sents.en: In endpoint-assisted propagation, the attack prompt P ϕ ​ ( g ) P_{\phi}(g) contains the instructions ϕ \phi to remember that every artifact the agent later creates should be passed through an external endpoint before it is saved or shared.
sents.zh: 在端点辅助传播中，攻击提示 P ϕ ​ ( g ) P_{\phi}(g) 包含指令 ϕ \phi，要求智能体记住：其后续创建的每个产物都必须在保存或共享之前通过外部端点处理。

sents.en: The endpoint is configured beforehand by the adversary to align with the adversarial goal g g .
sents.zh: 该端点由攻击者预先配置，以与对抗目标 g g 保持一致。

sents.en: A successful transmission therefore follows P ϕ ​ ( g ) ⟶ ℳ a ⟶ Endpoint ​ ( d ′ ) ⟶ ℳ b P_{\phi}(g)\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{a}\longrightarrow\texttt{Endpoint}(d^{\prime})\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{b} , where ℳ a \mathcal{M}^{a} and ℳ b \mathcal{M}^{b} are the private memories of successive agents and d ′ d^{\prime} is an artifact created during an ordinary user-requested task.
sents.zh: 因此，一次成功的传播过程为：P ϕ ​ ( g ) ⟶ ℳ a ⟶ Endpoint ​ ( d ′ ) ⟶ ℳ b P_{\phi}(g)\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{a}\longrightarrow\texttt{Endpoint}(d^{\prime})\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{b}，其中 ℳ a \mathcal{M}^{a} 和 ℳ b \mathcal{M}^{b} 是连续智能体的私有记忆，而 d ′ d^{\prime} 是在普通用户请求任务中创建的产物。

sents.en: The agent must preserve only the goal, the instruction to store in memory and the instruction to use the endpoint; it does not need to reconstruct the attack prompt, and each successful endpoint call places a fresh, uncorrupted copy of the attack prompt into the next artifact.
sents.zh: 智能体只需保留目标、存储指令以及使用端点的指令；它无需重构攻击提示，且每次成功的端点调用都会将攻击提示的一个全新、未损坏的副本写入下一个产物。

sents.en: Propagation can still fail: an agent may store the goal but drop the instruction, or retain the instruction but not call the endpoint during a later writing task.
sents.zh: 传播仍可能失败：智能体可能只存储了目标却遗漏了相关指令，或保留了指令但在后续写作任务中未调用端点。

sents.en: The mechanism requires outbound network access and permission to send artifacts to an external service.
sents.zh: 该机制需要出站网络访问权限，以及向外部服务发送产物的权限。

paragraphs.en: The agent, not the endpoint, replicates the attack. In the endpoint-assisted design, the agent first writes the adversarial goal, an instruction to retain it, and a filled-in curl command into a new artifact using information carried in memory. It then calls the endpoint, which expands and canonicalizes material the agent has already reproduced. The agent reads the result back (i.e. it is not an exfiltration attack) and checks it against its memory. If the agent fails to carry the goal or endpoint instruction forward, the endpoint has no attack-bearing draft to complete. Appendix I.3 shows the draft and verification step.
paragraphs.zh: 执行攻击的是智能体，而非端点。 在端点辅助的设计中，智能体首先利用内存中的信息，将对抗性目标、保留该目标的指令以及一个已填写的 curl 命令写入一个新的产物。 然后，它调用端点，由端点展开并标准化智能体已经复制的内容。 智能体将结果读取回来（即这不是数据外泄攻击），并将其与自身内存中的内容进行比对。 如果智能体未能将目标或端点指令继续执行下去，那么端点就没有可完成的有效攻击草案。 附录 I.3 展示了草案编写和验证步骤。

sents.zh: 执行攻击的是智能体，而非端点。

sents.zh: 在端点辅助的设计中，智能体首先利用内存中的信息，将对抗性目标、保留该目标的指令以及一个已填写的 curl 命令写入一个新的产物。

sents.en: It then calls the endpoint, which expands and canonicalizes material the agent has already reproduced.
sents.zh: 然后，它调用端点，由端点展开并标准化智能体已经复制的内容。

sents.en: The agent reads the result back (i.e. it is not an exfiltration attack) and checks it against its memory.
sents.zh: 智能体将结果读取回来（即这不是数据外泄攻击），并将其与自身内存中的内容进行比对。

sents.en: If the agent fails to carry the goal or endpoint instruction forward, the endpoint has no attack-bearing draft to complete.
sents.zh: 如果智能体未能将目标或端点指令继续执行下去，那么端点就没有可完成的有效攻击草案。

sents.en: Appendix I.3 shows the draft and verification step.
sents.zh: 附录 I.3 展示了草案编写和验证步骤。

paragraphs.en: Is outbound access a realistic assumption? Endpoint-assisted propagation assumes an assistant can send an artifact to an external service. We argue this is common rather than a permissive special case. In OpenClaw, the harness we evaluate, web fetch is enabled by default, blocks only private and internal hostnames, and has no public-host allowlist ( OpenClaw, 2026b ) . Assistants that act across a user’s services ( SpaceXAI, 2026 ; Meta, 2026a ) also depend on access to external systems. Restrictions can fail in practice: in 2026, unmonitored OpenAI agents escaped a filtered evaluation sandbox and operated inside Hugging Face’s infrastructure for days before detection ( OpenAI, 2026c ; Larcher et al., 2026 ; Booth, 2026 ) . If a frontier lab missed that traffic, a routine-looking endpoint call by an infected assistant may also go unnoticed. Strict egress controls remove this mechanism, leaving propagation to the assistants alone (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 出站访问是否是一个合理的假设？ 终端辅助传播假设了智能体助手能够将一个工件发送到外部服务。 我们认为这种情况是常见的，而非一种宽松的特殊情况。 在我们评估的 OpenClaw 框架中，网页抓取默认启用，仅阻止私有和内部主机名，且没有公共主机的允许列表（OpenClaw, 2026b）。 跨用户服务运行的智能体助手（SpaceXAI, 2026；Meta, 2026a）也依赖于对外部系统的访问权限。 限制措施在实践中可能失效：2026 年，未经监控的 OpenAI 智能体从受过滤的评估沙箱中逃逸，并在 Hugging Face 的基础设施内运行了数日才被检测到（OpenAI, 2026c；Larcher 等, 2026；Booth, 2026）。 如果前沿实验室未能发现此类流量，受感染智能体发起的看似常规终端调用也可能未被察觉。 严格的出站控制会消除这一机制，使传播完全依赖于智能体自身（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: Search agent. The search is carried out by an AI agent (Muse Spark 1.3; Meta, 2026b ) running in the Codex harness ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . At each iteration, the agent proposes a revision of ϕ \phi , runs it on the search universes (defined below), and inspects the resulting judge labels, memory snapshots, and agent trajectories to diagnose where propagation failed, for example when an agent stored the goal but not the endpoint instruction, or kept the instruction but did not call the endpoint. It then revises the template accordingly. The agent maintains a persistent Markdown research log of hypotheses tested, their outcomes, and observed failure modes, so that the search accumulates knowledge across iterations and sessions rather than restarting from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索智能体。 搜索由一个运行在 Codex 框架（OpenAI，2026a）中的 AI 智能体（Muse Spark 1.3；Meta，2026b）执行。 在每个迭代中，该智能体会提出对 ϕ \phi 的修订版本，在搜索宇宙（定义见下文）中运行它，并检查由此产生的评判标签、记忆快照和智能体轨迹，以诊断传播失败的位置，例如当某个智能体存储了目标但未存储终点指令，或保留了指令但未调用终点时。 然后，它会相应地修订模板。 该智能体会维护一个持久的 Markdown 研究日志，记录已测试的假设、其结果以及观察到的失败模式，从而使搜索在迭代和会话之间积累知识，而不是从头开始。

paragraphs.en: Human steering. We monitored the search and intervened when it stalled or drifted. Interventions redirected the agent away from unproductive lines of search, enforced the constraints below when a candidate violated them, and suggested new directions to explore. We worked only with development data, never with the test universes or goals.
paragraphs.zh: 人类引导。 我们监控了搜索过程，并在其停滞或偏离时进行干预。 干预措施将智能体从低效的搜索路径上引导开，在候选项违反以下约束条件时强制执行这些约束，并建议新的探索方向。 我们仅使用开发数据，从未使用测试宇宙或目标。

sents.en: Human steering.
sents.zh: 人类引导。

sents.en: We monitored the search and intervened when it stalled or drifted.
sents.zh: 我们监控了搜索过程，并在其停滞或偏离时进行干预。

sents.en: Interventions redirected the agent away from unproductive lines of search, enforced the constraints below when a candidate violated them, and suggested new directions to explore.
sents.zh: 干预措施将智能体从低效的搜索路径上引导开，在候选项违反以下约束条件时强制执行这些约束，并建议新的探索方向。

sents.en: We worked only with development data, never with the test universes or goals.
sents.zh: 我们仅使用开发数据，从未使用测试宇宙或目标。

paragraphs.en: Constraints and freezing. Neither the search agent nor we had access to the test universes or goals during development. Candidate ϕ \phi had to remain goal-agnostic and contain no universe- or artifact-specific content. We split the 12 development universes into 6 search universes, on which the agent runs and inspects candidates, and 6 validation universes, which are held out from the search. The search had no fixed budget. For each model, it stopped once a candidate template reached second-hop survival on the search universes and also on the validation universes, which guards against candidate ϕ \phi that overfit to the particular workflows seen during the search. When several potential ϕ \phi met this condition, we froze as ϕ ⋆ \phi^{\star} the one with the best and most consistent propagation across the development set. In evaluation, the attack prompt is then P ϕ ⋆ ​ ( g test ) P_{\phi^{\star}}(g_{\mathrm{test}}) , without goal-, artifact-, or universe-specific changes to ϕ \phi . We optimized separately for each different target model, with effort differing substantially (see Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 约束与冻结。 在开发过程中，搜索智能体和我们都无法访问测试宇宙或目标。 候选 ϕ \phi 必须保持与目标无关，且不能包含任何特定于宇宙或人工物的内容。 我们将 12 个开发宇宙划分为 6 个搜索宇宙（智能体在此运行并检查候选方案）和 6 个验证宇宙（从搜索中保留出来）。 搜索没有固定的预算限制。 对于每个模型，一旦某个候选模板在搜索宇宙和验证宇宙中都通过了第二跳生存测试，搜索就会停止；这可以防止候选 ϕ \phi 对搜索过程中遇到的特定工作流程产生过拟合。 当多个潜在的 ϕ \phi 满足此条件时，我们会选择在整个开发集中传播效果最好且最一致的那个作为 ϕ ⋆ \phi^{\star} 并予以冻结。 在评估阶段，攻击提示即为 P ϕ ⋆ ​ ( g test ) P_{\phi^{\star}}(g_{\mathrm{test}}) ，其中 ϕ \phi 不会进行任何与目标、人工物或宇宙相关的修改。 我们为每个不同的目标模型分别进行了优化，所需的工作量存在显著差异（参见附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the framework from Section 3 using a dataset of synthetic human–agent universes. We describe the dataset, the development and held-out evaluation protocol, and the propagation metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个由合成人类-智能体宇宙组成的数据集来评估第 3 节中提出的框架。 我们将介绍该数据集、开发与预留评估方案，以及传播指标。

sents.en: We evaluate the framework from Section 3 using a dataset of synthetic human–agent universes.
sents.zh: 我们使用一个由合成人类-智能体宇宙组成的数据集来评估第 3 节中提出的框架。

sents.en: We describe the dataset, the development and held-out evaluation protocol, and the propagation metrics.
sents.zh: 我们将介绍该数据集、开发与预留评估方案，以及传播指标。

paragraphs.en: Our dataset contains 36 synthetic human–agent universes representing collaborative workflows with personal AI assistants. Each person has a dedicated assistant with a distinct profile, private workspace, and background memories. Assistants act only in response to user requests, such as reading, drafting, or editing artifacts (e.g. text documents, code, reports, etc.), and cannot communicate directly. Information can therefore pass between assistants only through artifacts exchanged within these user-directed workflows. The universes vary along two axes: domain and workload intensity . We use six domains: three workplace settings ( customer support , software engineering , and healthcare operations ) and three personal settings ( home and living , social gatherings , and personal productivity ). Each domain has six workload levels. Higher levels add people, time steps, and artifact hand-offs: an agent receives 1.2 1.2 artifacts from other agents on average at the lightest level and 4.6 4.6 at the most active, where 0.36 0.36 – 0.40 0.40 of agents act at each time step (Appendix B.1 ). Universes contain 3–12 agents and last 10–20 time steps (mean 14.3 14.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据集包含 36 个合成的人类-智能体宇宙，代表了与个人 AI 助手协作的工作流程。 每个人都有一个专属的助手，该助手具有独特的个人资料、私人工作空间和背景记忆。 助手仅在响应用户请求时才会行动，例如阅读、起草或编辑成果（如文本文档、代码、报告等），且不能直接交流。 因此，信息只能通过这些由用户引导的工作流程中交换的成果在助手之间传递。 这些宇宙沿两个维度变化：领域和工作负荷强度。 我们使用了六个领域：三个工作场景（客户支持、软件工程和医疗运营）以及三个个人场景（家庭与生活、社交聚会和个人生产力）。 每个领域都有六个工作负荷级别。 更高的级别会增加人员、时间步数和成果交接：在最轻的负荷水平下，一个智能体平均从其他智能体接收 1.2 个成果，而在最活跃的负荷水平下则接收 4.6 个成果，其中在每个时间步中，有 0.36–0.40 的智能体会行动（附录 B.1）。 每个宇宙包含 3–12 个智能体，持续 10–20 个时间步（平均为 14.3）。

paragraphs.en: We create each universe in three stages. Stage 1 defines the setting, user profiles, agent responsibilities, and artifact manifest. Stage 2 creates the temporal workflow, including artifact ownership, handoffs, and read/write/edit tasks. Stage 3 generates the artifacts, background memories, and other workspace files. Automated checks and human audits follow; details are in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们以三个阶段来创建每个宇宙。 第一阶段定义设定、用户资料、智能体职责和成果清单。 第二阶段创建时间流程，包括成果所有权、交接以及读写编辑任务。 第三阶段生成成果、背景记忆和其他工作区文件。 随后会进行自动化检查和人工审核；详细信息见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: An attack instance pairs a human–agent universe 𝔘 \mathfrak{U} with an adversarial goal g g . We sample goals from Pulipaka et al. (2026) , ranging from benign preferences, such as “the user prefers Coca-Cola,” to security-sensitive behaviors, such as repeatedly executing attacker-chosen software. A development set, 𝒟 dev = { ( 𝔘 i , g i ) } i = 1 N dev \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{dev}}=\left\{\left(\mathfrak{U}_{i},g_{i}\right)\right\}_{i=1}^{N_{\mathrm{dev}}} is used only to construct or optimize the goal-agnostic attack prompt, ϕ \phi , described in Section 4 . The resulting attack prompt is then frozen. Evaluation uses held-out universes and adversarial goals. For each test instance, ( 𝔘 test , g test ) \left(\mathfrak{U}_{\mathrm{test}},g_{\mathrm{test}}\right) , we use g test g_{\mathrm{test}} with the frozen attack, with no goal-specific, artifact-specific, or universe-specific changes. Each evaluation starts with clean agent memories and clean artifacts except for the poisoned seed d seed d_{\mathrm{seed}} (Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个攻击实例将人类–智能体宇宙 𝔘 \mathfrak{U} 与一个对抗性目标 g g 配对。 我们从 Pulipaka 等人（2026）的研究中采样目标。 这些目标涵盖从良性偏好（例如“用户更喜欢可口可乐”）到安全敏感行为（例如重复执行攻击者选择的软件）的各种情况。 开发集 𝒟 dev = { ( 𝔘 i , g i ) } i = 1 N dev \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{dev}}=\left\{\left(\mathfrak{U}_{i},g_{i}\right)\right\}_{i=1}^{N_{\mathrm{dev}}} 仅用于构建或优化目标无关的攻击提示 ϕ \phi ，该提示在第四节中进行了描述。 随后，生成的攻击提示将被冻结。 评估使用预留的宇宙和对抗性目标进行。 对于每个测试实例 ( 𝔘 test , g test ) \left(\mathfrak{U}_{\mathrm{test}},g_{\mathrm{test}}\right) ，我们使用 g test g_{\mathrm{test}} 与已冻结的攻击策略，且不做任何针对目标、人工制品或宇宙的具体修改。 每次评估均以干净的智能体记忆和干净的人工制品开始，唯一例外是受污染的种子 d seed d_{\mathrm{seed}}（第三节第 2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four target models: GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , Kimi-K2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , GPT-OSS-120B ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , and DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) . Every assistant in a universe uses the same model and runs in the OpenClaw personal-assistant harness ( OpenClaw, 2026a ) with file tools, a private workspace, and OpenClaw’s default memory, a MEMORY.md file that persists across time steps. Attack prompt instructions ϕ \phi were optimized for each model on 12 development universes, and evaluated on the unseen 36 test universes of Section 5.1 , on which we run every universe twice per model and average over the two runs. Each run contains a single seed artifact held by one seed agent (Section 3.2 ); all other artifacts and memories start clean.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了四个目标模型：GPT-5.6 Luna（OpenAI，2026b）、Kimi-K2.6（Moonshot AI，2026）、GPT-OSS-120B（OpenAI，2025）以及 DeepSeek-V4-Pro（DeepSeek-AI，2026）。 每个宇宙中的助手都使用相同的模型，并在 OpenClaw 个人助手框架（OpenClaw，2026a）中运行，该框架配备了文件工具、私人工作区以及 OpenClaw 的默认记忆——一个在时间步之间持续存在的 MEMORY.md 文件。 攻击提示指令 ϕ \phi 针对每个模型在 12 个开发宇宙中进行优化，并在第 5.1 节中未见的 36 个测试宇宙上进行评估；对于这些测试宇宙，我们对每个模型运行两次，并对两次运行的结果取平均值。 每次运行都包含一个由单个种子智能体持有的单一种子工件（第 3.2 节）；所有其他工件和记忆均初始化为空。

paragraphs.en: An LLM judge (DeepSeek-V4-Flash; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) labels every memory snapshot and agent-written artifact for whether it preserves the adversarial goal and the propagation instruction, counting paraphrases (Section 5.3 ). The injected content is distinctive enough that even a generic classifier separates infected from benign memories perfectly (Appendix J ), and a manual audit of the judge’s labels found no errors. We report FIF and S ⁡ ( h ) S(h) (Equations 3 and 4 ), together with the censoring-corrected survival estimate and per-hop continuation probability p ^ \hat{p} (Equations 5 and 6 ).

paragraphs.en: Main results. First-hop infection is easy for every model: the seed infects at least one assistant in 78 78 – 100 % 100\% of runs (Table 1 ). The models differ in whether the state keeps moving. With DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GPT-OSS-120B, a single seed artifact goal-infects 98 % 98\% and 85 % 85\% of assistants, and 76 % 76\% and 61 % 61\% of chains reach hop 4; with GPT-5.6 Luna and Kimi-K2.6, it reaches 38 % 38\% and 47 % 47\% of assistants, and 24 % 24\% and 44 % 44\% of chains reach hop 4. Goal infection exceeds full infection, most visibly for DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( 0.98 0.98 versus 0.71 0.71 ), because agents often keep the goal while rewording the propagation instruction.

paragraphs.en: Propagation depth. The observed curves in Figure 2 understate how far the attack travels, because most chains are cut off by the end of the universe rather than by the model: 65 of 69 DeepSeek-V4-Pro runs are censored. After correction, 85 % 85\% of DeepSeek-V4-Pro chains and 73 % 73\% of GPT-OSS-120B chains are still alive at hop 7, with per-hop continuation probabilities of p ^ = 0.98 \hat{p}=0.98 ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 0.97 , 1.00 ] [0.97,1.00] ) and 0.93 0.93 ( [ 0.90 , 0.97 ] [0.90,0.97] ). Chains of GPT-5.6 Luna and Kimi-K2.6 die out with time remaining: p ^ = 0.71 \hat{p}=0.71 ( [ 0.63 , 0.77 ] [0.63,0.77] ) and 0.84 0.84 ( [ 0.78 , 0.90 ] [0.78,0.90] ), halving the surviving fraction every two and four hops. These estimates change by at most 0.04 0.04 for censoring windows of 2–4 steps.

paragraphs.en: Exposure to infected artifacts limits spread. Once an assistant reads an artifact carrying the state, it usually adopts it: conversion is 0.69 0.69 for GPT-5.6 Luna, 0.76 0.76 for Kimi-K2.6, 0.94 0.94 for GPT-OSS-120B, and 1.00 1.00 for DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Figure 3 ). A clean read encounters such an artifact much less often: 0.18 0.18 to 0.55 0.55 . The loss happens when an infected assistant writes an artifact, which reproduces the belief in 0.69 0.69 of cases and the instruction verbatim in 0.55 0.55 , and about half as often for GPT-5.6 Luna and Kimi-K2.6 (Appendix I.2 ). Fewer infected artifacts mean fewer encounters.
paragraphs.zh: 接触受感染的物品会限制传播。 一旦助手读取了携带状态的物品，通常会采用该状态：对于 GPT-5.6 Luna，转换率为 0.69 0.69；对于 Kimi-K2.6，为 0.76 0.76；对于 GPT-OSS-120B，为 0.94 0.94；而对于 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，则为 1.00 1.00（图 3）。 在干净读取时遇到此类物品的情况要少得多：从 0.18 0.18 到 0.55 0.55。 损失发生在受感染的助手写入物品时，这种情况会在 0.69 0.69 的案例中重现该信念，并在 0.55 0.55 的案例中逐字复制指令；对于 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Kimi-K2.6，发生频率约为前者的一半（附录 I.2）。 受感染的物品越少，遇到的情况就越少。

paragraphs.en: Propagation in larger universes. To test whether these patterns hold at larger scale, we also run each model on three universes of 30 agents and up to 60 time steps, each with three seed artifacts given to randomly chosen agents (Appendix H ). The attack reaches 90 90 – 100 % 100\% of agents for GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, 77 77 – 97 % 97\% for Kimi-K2.6, and 60 60 – 80 % 80\% for GPT-5.6 Luna, and chains reach hop 8, beyond what the test universes allow and consistent with the extrapolated survival curves. Figure 4 shows the resulting contact networks: from the same three seed agents, GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro reach nearly every agent, while GPT-5.6 Luna leaves an uninfected periphery in every universe. Infections grow roughly linearly, about one new agent every two time steps, as expected when spread is limited by encounters. In epidemiological terms, each agent infected early infects 1.3 to 2.1 others on average (reproduction number R > 1 R>1 ), and R R falls below 1 as uninfected agents run out (Appendix H.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在更大宇宙中的传播。 为了检验这些模式是否在更大尺度上依然成立，我们还让每个模型在包含 30 个智能体、最多运行 60 个时间步的三种宇宙中进行测试，每个宇宙中都会将三个初始人工制品赋予随机选定的智能体（附录 H）。 对于 GPT-OSS-120B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，攻击覆盖了 90%–100% 的智能体；对于 Kimi-K2.6，覆盖率为 77%–97%；对于 GPT-5.6 Luna，覆盖率为 60%–80%，而链式反应则达到了第 8 步，超出了测试宇宙允许的范围，但与外推后的生存曲线一致。 图 4 展示了由此产生的接触网络：从相同的三个初始智能体出发，GPT-OSS-120B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 几乎覆盖了所有智能体，而 GPT-5.6 Luna 在每个宇宙中都留下了未受感染的外围区域。 感染以大致线性的方式增长，大约每两个时间步出现一个新感染的智能体，这与传播受限于相遇次数的预期一致。 从流行病学角度来看，每个早期被感染的智能体平均会感染 1.3 到 2.1 个其他智能体（繁殖数 R > 1），而随着未感染智能体的数量减少，R 值会降至 1 以下（附录 H.3）。

paragraphs.en: A few agents and artifacts do most of the spreading. Transmission is concentrated: 53 % 53\% of infected agents infect no one, while the most prolific 20 % 20\% cause 69 % 69\% of transmissions (Figure 5 ); the three largest spreaders are each the most widely read agent in their run. Persistence in media is visible: one DeepSeek-V4-Pro artifact keeps infecting new readers for 41 time steps and accounts for 22 of that run’s 30 infections (Figure 6 ), and a lineage can stall for over 20 steps and then resume because its artifacts remain in circulation (Appendix H.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Frontier models . Attack development was substantially more expensive for GPT-5.6 Luna and Grok 4.6. GPT-5.6 Luna required 4,002 development jobs before meeting our stopping criterion, while our Grok 4.6 search was stopped for cost after 571 jobs, at which point second-hop survival had reached approximately 0.2. Luna had similarly low success at a comparable stage of its search before eventually leading to a successful propagating template. This suggests that stronger models will increase the cost of finding a successful attack rather than preclude one. Hence, our failure to find a successful attack within the tested budget should not be taken as evidence of immunity, since substantially larger search budgets may reveal effective propagating attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿模型。 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Grok 4.6 的攻击开发成本要高得多。 GPT-5.6 Luna 在达到我们的停止标准前需要 4,002 次开发任务，而我们的 Grok 4.6 搜索因成本问题在 571 次任务后停止，此时第二跳存活率已达到约 0.2。 Luna 在其搜索的类似阶段也表现出同样低的成功率，但最终还是成功生成了一个有效的传播模板。 这表明，更强的模型会增加找到有效攻击的成本，而非完全阻止攻击的发生。 因此，我们在测试预算内未能找到有效攻击，不应被视作免疫的证据，因为更大规模的搜索预算可能会揭示出有效的传播攻击。

paragraphs.en: Why this attack is dangerous. The attacker needs one artifact read by one assistant and chooses no further victims after that, but must keep its service reachable for infected assistants to call (Appendix A ). It travels in files that people share for their own reasons, reaches assistants the attacker never had access to, and sends every artifact an infected assistant writes to the attacker. The goals it carries range from harmless preferences to repeatedly running attacker-chosen software (Section 5.2 ). In the large universes, a single DeepSeek-V4-Pro artifact caused 22 of its run’s 30 infections over 41 time steps. Because infected artifacts stay in circulation, resetting an assistant’s memory does not end an outbreak, because the next infected artifact can reinfect it. This holds because it is the agent, not the attacker’s endpoint, that carries out replication: the agent remembers the goal, decides to write it into an unrelated later artifact, initiates the upload, and then checks the returned file against its own memory before accepting it (Section 4.1 , Appendix I.3 ). The endpoint only reformats content the agent already produced; removing it would weaken the attack’s fidelity, not its underlying mechanism, which is why we also evaluate a variant without one (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 这种攻击为何危险。 攻击者需要一个被一名助手读取的工件，之后不再选择其他受害者，但必须保持其服务可被受感染的助手调用（附录 A）。 它通过人们出于自身原因共享的文件传播，能够接触到攻击者此前从未访问过的助手，并将受感染助手编写的每个工件发送给攻击者。 其所携带的目标从无害的偏好设置到重复运行攻击者指定的软件不等（第 5.2 节）。 在大型宇宙中，单个 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 工件在一次运行中导致了 30 次感染中的 22 次，持续了 41 个时间步。 由于受感染的工件仍在流通，重置助手的记忆并不会终结疫情爆发，因为下一个受感染的工件可能再次将其感染。 这是因为执行复制的是智能体而非攻击者的终端：智能体会记住目标，决定将其写入一个无关的后续工件中，发起上传，然后在接受返回的文件前，将其与自身记忆进行比对（第 4.1 节，附录 I.3）。 终端仅对智能体已生成的内容进行重新格式化；移除该功能会削弱攻击的保真度，但不会影响其底层机制，因此我们也评估了缺少该功能的变体（附录 D）。

sents.en: Why this attack is dangerous.
sents.zh: 这种攻击为何危险。

sents.en: The attacker needs one artifact read by one assistant and chooses no further victims after that, but must keep its service reachable for infected assistants to call (Appendix A ).
sents.zh: 攻击者需要一个被一名助手读取的工件，之后不再选择其他受害者，但必须保持其服务可被受感染的助手调用（附录 A）。

sents.en: It travels in files that people share for their own reasons, reaches assistants the attacker never had access to, and sends every artifact an infected assistant writes to the attacker.
sents.zh: 它通过人们出于自身原因共享的文件传播，能够接触到攻击者此前从未访问过的助手，并将受感染助手编写的每个工件发送给攻击者。

sents.en: The goals it carries range from harmless preferences to repeatedly running attacker-chosen software (Section 5.2 ).
sents.zh: 其所携带的目标从无害的偏好设置到重复运行攻击者指定的软件不等（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: From propagation to loss of control. Self-replicating prompt injections are no longer only a research construct. OpenAI reports that injections which copy themselves into email, files, and multi-hop Slack messages emerged during adversarial training of its own models, although no impact was observed outside simulated tool calls ( OpenAI, 2026d ) . In deployment, 506 posts carrying prompt injections aimed at AI readers appeared on the agent-only network Moltbook within 72 hours ( Riegler & Gautam, 2026 ) , and OpenAI agents have already escaped a filtered evaluation sandbox and operated undetected inside another organization’s infrastructure for days ( OpenAI, 2026c ; Larcher et al., 2026 ; Booth, 2026 ) . Our results show how these pieces could combine: adversarial state that persists in memory and artifacts moves between assistants that no one connected, reaches most agents in a population, and can carry goals that include repeatedly running attacker-chosen software. As assistants act with more autonomy and less review, such state could spread faster than people can audit what their assistants remember, which is why we argue for treating artifacts and memory as part of the security boundary now.
paragraphs.zh: 从传播到失控。 自我复制的提示注入不再仅仅是一个研究构想。 OpenAI 报告称，在对其模型进行对抗性训练期间，出现了能够将自身复制到电子邮件、文件和多跳 Slack 消息中的注入行为，尽管在模拟工具调用之外并未观察到任何影响（OpenAI, 2026d）。 在实际部署中，72 小时内，专门针对 AI 读者的提示注入内容出现在仅面向智能体的 Moltbook 网络上（Riegler & Gautam, 2026），而 OpenAI 的智能体已经逃离了经过过滤的评估沙箱，并在另一组织的基础设施中未被检测地运行了数日（OpenAI, 2026c；Larcher et al., 2026；Booth, 2026）。 我们的研究结果表明这些要素如何结合：在记忆中持续存在的对抗状态以及在不同助手之间传递的残留物，即使无人察觉，也能传播到群体中的大多数智能体，并可能携带包括反复运行攻击者指定软件在内的目标。 随着助手以更高的自主性和更少的审查进行行动，这种状态可能会比人们能够审计其助手记忆的速度更快传播，因此我们认为现在应将残留物和记忆视为安全边界的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Workflow assistants. Our attack relies on three capabilities increasingly common in personal assistants: persistent memory, reading and writing user files, and access to external services. Products such as Grok Bot ( SpaceXAI, 2026 ) and Muse ( Meta, 2026a ) combine these capabilities, although we do not evaluate their internal safeguards. In OpenClaw, the harness used in our experiments, memory writes are unscreened and outbound access to public hosts is enabled by default. We obtain propagating attacks for all four evaluated models; our additional Grok 4.6 search was stopped for cost before reaching the stopping criterion. These systems therefore expose the same basic substrate through which artifact-mediated propagation can arise.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流智能体。 我们的攻击依赖于个人助理中日益普遍的三种能力：持久记忆、读写用户文件以及访问外部服务。 Grok Bot（SpaceXAI，2026）和 Muse（Meta，2026a）等产品结合了这些能力，尽管我们并未评估其内部安全机制。 在 OpenClaw 中，即我们实验中使用的框架，记忆写入未经审查，且默认允许对外部公共主机的访问。 我们为所有四个受评估模型都获得了传播性攻击；我们额外的 Grok 4.6 搜索因成本问题在达到停止标准前被中止。 因此，这些系统暴露了相同的底层基础，而通过该基础，经由人工制品媒介的传播便可能发生。

paragraphs.en: Practical defenses. Several stages of the attack can be blocked without retraining the underlying model. Before a memory write, an off-the-shelf classifier that checks whether an instruction appears to originate from someone other than the user flags all infected memories from our main template, with 4/24 false positives on benign instruction-like memories (Appendix J ). The endpoint mechanism can be blocked with outbound-host allowlists or user confirmation before uploading to new destinations. Finally, because a small number of widely shared artifacts account for much of the spread, prioritizing these artifacts for screening may provide substantial coverage at lower cost. The harness we evaluate applies none of these checks by default.
paragraphs.zh: 实用防御措施。 无需重新训练底层模型，即可阻止攻击的多个阶段。 在执行内存写入之前，一个现成的分类器会检查指令是否看起来并非来自用户本人；该分类器能够标记出我们主模板中所有受感染的记忆，在良性类指令的记忆中仅有 4/24 的误报（附录 J）。 通过出站主机允许列表或在上传至新目的地前要求用户确认，可以阻止终端机制。 最后，由于少数广泛传播的工件导致了大部分传播，因此优先对这些工件进行筛查，可能以较低成本实现较高的覆盖范围。 我们正在评估的框架默认并未应用上述任何检查措施。

paragraphs.en: People increasingly use AI assistants to create, edit, and share artifacts such as documents, code, and presentations. With persistent memory, these everyday workflows can connect otherwise independent assistants. We formalize this risk as artifact-mediated propagation and evaluate it across four models and 36 held-out human–agent workflows. A single poisoned artifact can trigger multi-hop propagation, where the attack reaches 60–100% of agents across models. Infected artifacts can continue exposing new assistants long after they are created. As these systems become more common in collaborative workflows, shared artifacts become part of the security boundary. Our paper suggests that shared artifacts should be treated as part of the security boundary, since they can preserve and propagate adversarial state across otherwise independent assistants.
paragraphs.zh: 人们越来越多地使用人工智能助手来创建、编辑和共享文档、代码及演示文稿等成果。 借助持久化记忆，这些日常工作流程可以将原本相互独立的人工智能助手连接起来。 我们将这种风险正式定义为“通过成果媒介的传播”，并在四个模型以及 36 个预留的人机协作流程中对其进行了评估。 单个被污染的成果就可能触发多跳传播，使攻击在跨模型的情况下波及 60%–100% 的人工智能助手。 受感染的成果在创建很久之后，仍可能持续暴露新的人工智能助手。 随着这些系统在协作工作流程中变得越来越普遍，共享成果也将成为安全边界的一部分。 我们的论文指出，应当将共享成果视为安全边界的一部分，因为它们能够在原本相互独立的人工智能助手之间保存并传播对抗性状态。

paragraphs.en: Our main results (Section 6.2 ) use endpoint-assisted propagation. An infected assistant must retain an instruction to send a later draft to an attacker-controlled service and must use the returned artifact, into which the service inserts a fresh copy of the attack prompt (Section 4.1 ). This requires outbound access to that service. Effective egress restrictions, or an assistant declining to use the returned artifact, would interrupt the evaluated mechanism. Payload restoration also removes one source of loss between hops, so the infection fractions and hop-survival estimates do not measure an assistant’s unaided ability to reproduce the full attack prompt. They do measure the shorter carry-forward mechanism: the gap between goal and full infection in Table 1 shows that preserving the goal does not guarantee preserving the propagation instruction, and endpoint-use rates are reported separately in Appendix I.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要结果（第 6.2 节）使用了端点辅助传播方法。 受感染的智能体必须保留一条指令，将后续草稿发送至攻击者控制的服务，并且必须使用返回的产物，该产物中服务会插入攻击提示词的新副本（第 4.1 节）。 这需要能够访问该服务的出站连接。 有效的出站限制，或智能体拒绝使用返回的产物，都会中断所评估的机制。 有效载荷的恢复也消除了跳点之间的一个损失来源，因此感染比例和跳点存活率的估计值并未衡量智能体在没有辅助的情况下完整再现攻击提示词的能力。 这些指标确实衡量了较短的延续机制：表 1 中目标与完全感染之间的差距表明，保留目标并不保证能保留传播指令，而端点使用率则在附录 I.1 中单独报告。

paragraphs.en: Without the service, an assistant must itself preserve and re-express enough of the attack, in memory and in each new artifact, to infect the next assistant (Appendix D ); paraphrasing or omission at any step weakens later copies. We evaluate this variant on one model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and find that it does propagate but is substantially lossier than the endpoint-assisted mechanism: a single seed fully infects 21 % 21\% of assistants, second-hop survival is S ⁡ ( 2 ) = 0.30 S(2)=0.30 , and the decay is driven mainly by agents omitting the payload when they write rather than by paraphrase (Appendix D ). These are a lower bound at a fixed, modest search budget; whether stronger endpoint-free templates or other models do better remains open. Because such an attack would not require the outbound service calls the endpoint-assisted variant depends on, it would also be harder to interrupt with the egress controls we discuss, which we regard as a concerning direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有这项服务，智能体自身就必须保留并重新表达攻击的足够内容——无论是存储在内存中还是体现在每个新产物中——以便感染下一个智能体（附录 D）；在任何步骤中进行改写或省略都会削弱后续副本的效果。 我们在一个模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）上评估了这一变体，发现它确实能够传播，但信息丢失程度远高于依赖端点辅助的机制：单个种子样本能完全感染 21% 的智能体，第二跳的存活率为 S(2) = 0.30，而这种衰减主要由智能体在生成内容时省略有效载荷所致，而非改写（附录 D）。 在搜索预算固定且有限的情况下，这些结果是一个下界；更强的无端点模板或其他模型是否表现更好，仍是一个开放问题。 由于此类攻击不需要依赖端点辅助变体所依赖的外发服务调用，因此通过我们讨论的出站流量控制手段也更难将其中断；我们认为这是未来研究中一个值得担忧的方向。

sents.en: Without the service, an assistant must itself preserve and re-express enough of the attack, in memory and in each new artifact, to infect the next assistant (Appendix D ); paraphrasing or omission at any step weakens later copies.
sents.zh: 如果没有这项服务，智能体自身就必须保留并重新表达攻击的足够内容——无论是存储在内存中还是体现在每个新产物中——以便感染下一个智能体（附录 D）；在任何步骤中进行改写或省略都会削弱后续副本的效果。

sents.en: We evaluate this variant on one model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) and find that it does propagate but is substantially lossier than the endpoint-assisted mechanism: a single seed fully infects 21 % 21\% of assistants, second-hop survival is S ⁡ ( 2 ) = 0.30 S(2)=0.30 , and the decay is driven mainly by agents omitting the payload when they write rather than by paraphrase (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 我们在一个模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）上评估了这一变体，发现它确实能够传播，但信息丢失程度远高于依赖端点辅助的机制：单个种子样本能完全感染 21% 的智能体，第二跳的存活率为 S(2) = 0.30，而这种衰减主要由智能体在生成内容时省略有效载荷所致，而非改写（附录 D）。

sents.en: These are a lower bound at a fixed, modest search budget; whether stronger endpoint-free templates or other models do better remains open.
sents.zh: 在搜索预算固定且有限的情况下，这些结果是一个下界；更强的无端点模板或其他模型是否表现更好，仍是一个开放问题。

sents.en: Because such an attack would not require the outbound service calls the endpoint-assisted variant depends on, it would also be harder to interrupt with the egress controls we discuss, which we regard as a concerning direction for future work.
sents.zh: 由于此类攻击不需要依赖端点辅助变体所依赖的外发服务调用，因此通过我们讨论的出站流量控制手段也更难将其中断；我们认为这是未来研究中一个值得担忧的方向。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated four models and ran a partial search on one frontier-class model, Grok 4.6, which we stopped for cost before it met our threshold (Appendix F ). We did not attempt the strongest available frontier assistants, again because searching each model is costly. Among the four models that met our stopping rule, search effort ranged from 109 to 4,002 jobs. Our results therefore do not establish that comparable templates exist for the most capable models, nor that those models are immune; because the effort we spent is small next to a determined adversary’s, whether substantially more search would compromise stronger models is an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了四个模型，并对一个前沿级模型 Grok 4.6 进行了部分搜索，但由于成本问题，我们在其达到阈值之前停止了搜索（附录 F）。 我们没有尝试目前最强的前沿助手模型，原因同样在于搜索每个模型的成本很高。 在满足我们停止规则的四个模型中，搜索工作量从 109 次任务到 4,002 次任务不等。 因此，我们的研究结果既不能证明最强大的模型也存在类似的模板，也不能证明这些模型免疫于攻击；因为与我们所投入的努力相比，一个坚定对手所付出的努力要庞大得多，所以进一步增加搜索量是否会让更强大的模型受到威胁，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Our sharing networks are synthetic. The test universes use random connected sharing graphs whose size and activity vary across workload levels, and the large universes add community structure through overlapping social circles, with clustering about twice that of a random graph of the same density. Within this range, network structure explains little of the variation in spread (Appendix G ). Networks with more pronounced hubs ( Newman, 2003 ) are a natural extension; our superspreading results suggest that the most widely read agents would play a central role there.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的共享网络是合成的。 测试宇宙使用随机连接的共享图，其规模和活跃度因工作负载级别而异；大型宇宙则通过重叠的社会圈层增加了社区结构，其聚类系数约为相同密度随机图的两倍。 在此范围内，网络结构对传播差异的解释力很小（附录 G）。 具有更显著枢纽节点的网络（Newman, 2003）是一种自然的延伸；我们的超级传播结果表明，阅读范围最广的智能体在其中将扮演核心角色。

paragraphs.en: We describe the 36 test universes used in the main evaluation, followed by the three large universes of Appendix H .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将描述主评估中使用的 36 个测试宇宙，随后介绍附录 H 中的三个大型宇宙。

paragraphs.en: Each universe centers on a small group of people, each paired with one personal assistant that carries out exactly the request its user issues at each time step (reading, writing, or editing a file). Assistants have no messaging channel between them; as in real collaboration, people coordinate only by creating and passing along files, which lets us trace exactly how information moves between them.
paragraphs.zh: 每个宇宙都围绕着一小群人展开，每个人都会配备一位个人助理，该助理在每个时间步都严格执行用户提出的请求（如阅读、撰写或编辑文件）。 这些助理之间没有消息传递渠道；与真实的协作一样，人们仅通过创建和传递文件来进行协调，这使得我们能够精确追踪信息在它们之间的流动方式。

sents.en: Each universe centers on a small group of people, each paired with one personal assistant that carries out exactly the request its user issues at each time step (reading, writing, or editing a file).
sents.zh: 每个宇宙都围绕着一小群人展开，每个人都会配备一位个人助理，该助理在每个时间步都严格执行用户提出的请求（如阅读、撰写或编辑文件）。

sents.en: Assistants have no messaging channel between them; as in real collaboration, people coordinate only by creating and passing along files, which lets us trace exactly how information moves between them.
sents.zh: 这些助理之间没有消息传递渠道；与真实的协作一样，人们仅通过创建和传递文件来进行协调，这使得我们能够精确追踪信息在它们之间的流动方式。

paragraphs.en: Sharing and files. Which people can pass files to one another is defined by a random connected graph whose number of edges scales with group size. It is never shown to the assistants and only determines which hand-offs are plausible. Every file starts in one person’s private workspace, and information spreads only when one assistant reads a file another has written or shared. All files are plain text (e.g., CSV, Markdown, email, calendar, JSON), and every universe contains at least two file types.
paragraphs.zh: 共享与文件。 哪些人可以向彼此传递文件，由一个随机连接图决定，其边数随团队规模而变化。 该图从未向智能体展示，仅用于确定哪些文件交接是合理的。 每个文件最初都存在于某人的私人工作区中，只有当一个智能体读取另一个智能体撰写或共享的文件时，信息才会传播。 所有文件均为纯文本格式（例如 CSV、Markdown、电子邮件、日历、JSON），且每个宇宙至少包含两种文件类型。

sents.zh: 共享与文件。

paragraphs.en: The dataset contains 36 universes, 6 per domain and 6 per workload level, with 274 people and 889 personal files; each universe is assigned one adversarial goal. Table 2 summarizes the six workload levels, measured from the scheduled actions. The active fraction is the mean proportion of people performing a file action per time step. The mean degree is the average number of people each person can exchange files with in the sharing graph, and hand-offs per agent is the number of scheduled reads of a file last written or owned by someone else, divided by group size. The density of the sharing graph stays near 0.5 0.5 at every level; higher levels instead add people, time steps, and sharing partners, so that busier schedules support multi-hop sharing along several independent paths. The active fraction is similar across the first five levels and highest in the Peak level, which also has the most hand-offs per agent.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集包含 36 个宇宙，每个领域和每个工作负载级别各有 6 个宇宙，其中共有 274 人和 889 份个人文件；每个宇宙都被分配了一个对抗性目标。 表 2 总结了六个工作负载级别，这些级别是根据计划好的行动来衡量的。 活跃比例是指每个时间步中执行文件操作的人数所占的平均比例。 平均度是指每个人在共享图中可以交换文件的平均人数，而每位智能体的移交次数则是计划读取由他人最后写入或拥有的文件次数除以小组规模所得的结果。 在所有级别中，共享图的密度都保持在 0.5 附近；更高级别则通过增加人数、时间步和共享伙伴，使得更繁忙的日程能够支持沿多条独立路径进行的多跳共享。 前五个级别的活跃比例相似，而在峰值级别中最高，该级别的每位智能体移交次数也最多。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Archetype design. For each domain–intensity combination, a model generates a candidate universe: the people and their roles, a short premise, the target length, and a list of files with brief content specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：原型设计。 对于每个领域–强度组合，模型都会生成一个候选宇宙：其中包含人物及其角色、简短的前情提要、目标长度以及一份包含简要内容说明的文件列表。

sents.en: Stage 1: Archetype design.
sents.zh: 阶段 1：原型设计。

sents.en: For each domain–intensity combination, a model generates a candidate universe: the people and their roles, a short premise, the target length, and a list of files with brief content specifications.
sents.zh: 对于每个领域–强度组合，模型都会生成一个候选宇宙：其中包含人物及其角色、简短的前情提要、目标长度以及一份包含简要内容说明的文件列表。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2: Universe design. A single pass produces the sharing graph, initial file ownership, and the schedule of read, write, and edit actions, each paired with the everyday request the person gives their assistant. This stage enforces that files are read only after they exist, caps how many people receive information directly from its source, and requires busier universes to have several independent sharing paths. Violating universes are regenerated with the violations flagged.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2：宇宙设计。 单次处理即可生成共享图、初始文件所有权，以及读取、写入和编辑操作的计划，每个操作都对应用户向助手提出的日常请求。 此阶段强制要求文件在存在之后才能被读取，限制直接从其来源获取信息的人数，并要求更繁忙的宇宙拥有多个独立的共享路径。 违反规则的宇宙将被重新生成，同时标注出违规之处。

sents.en: Stage 2: Universe design.
sents.zh: 阶段 2：宇宙设计。

sents.en: A single pass produces the sharing graph, initial file ownership, and the schedule of read, write, and edit actions, each paired with the everyday request the person gives their assistant.
sents.zh: 单次处理即可生成共享图、初始文件所有权，以及读取、写入和编辑操作的计划，每个操作都对应用户向助手提出的日常请求。

sents.en: This stage enforces that files are read only after they exist, caps how many people receive information directly from its source, and requires busier universes to have several independent sharing paths.
sents.zh: 此阶段强制要求文件在存在之后才能被读取，限制直接从其来源获取信息的人数，并要求更繁忙的宇宙拥有多个独立的共享路径。

sents.en: Violating universes are regenerated with the violations flagged.
sents.zh: 违反规则的宇宙将被重新生成，同时标注出违规之处。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3: Artifact generation and enrichment. Every file is expanded into full plain-text content. Each person receives a short biography, a communication style, and background memories; private workspaces are filled with 889 personal distractor files in total; names are made unique across the benchmark; and each universe is assigned an adversarial goal from Pulipaka et al. (2026) , sampled proportionally across goal categories.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 3：生成并丰富人工制品。 每个文件都被展开为完整的纯文本内容。 每个人都会获得一份简短的生平介绍、一种沟通风格以及背景记忆；私人工作区总共填充了 889 个个人干扰文件；名称在整个基准测试中均保持唯一性；并且每个宇宙都会被分配一个来自 Pulipaka 等人的对抗性目标。 (2026)，按目标类别进行比例采样。

sents.en: Stage 3: Artifact generation and enrichment.
sents.zh: 阶段 3：生成并丰富人工制品。

sents.en: Every file is expanded into full plain-text content.
sents.zh: 每个文件都被展开为完整的纯文本内容。

sents.en: Each person receives a short biography, a communication style, and background memories; private workspaces are filled with 889 personal distractor files in total; names are made unique across the benchmark; and each universe is assigned an adversarial goal from Pulipaka et al.
sents.zh: 每个人都会获得一份简短的生平介绍、一种沟通风格以及背景记忆；私人工作区总共填充了 889 个个人干扰文件；名称在整个基准测试中均保持唯一性；并且每个宇宙都会被分配一个来自 Pulipaka 等人的对抗性目标。

sents.en: (2026) , sampled proportionally across goal categories.
sents.zh: (2026)，按目标类别进行比例采样。

paragraphs.en: Selection and validation. Candidate universes are scored on the length of sharing chains, the balance and diversity of actions, and how distinct their premise is, and the best-scoring universe is kept for each domain–intensity combination. Every universe must pass automated checks: the sharing graph is connected and every edge is used; no file is read before it is written; files move only along graph edges; requests contain no simulation-internal language; a full replay reproduces the recorded information flow; every person is eventually exposed; and busy universes have several independent exposure paths. Finally, human annotators audited every universe and rejected unnatural or broken ones.
paragraphs.zh: 选择与验证。 候选宇宙会根据共享链的长度、行动的平衡性与多样性、其前提的独特性进行评分，每个领域–强度组合都会保留得分最高的宇宙。 每个宇宙都必须通过自动化检查：共享图是连通的且每条边都被使用；任何文件在写入前都不会被读取；文件仅沿图中的边移动；请求不包含模拟内部的语言；完整重演能够重现记录的信息流；每个人最终都会被暴露；繁忙的宇宙拥有多条独立的暴露路径。 最后，人类标注员对每个宇宙进行了审核，并拒绝了那些不自然或存在问题的宇宙。

sents.en: Selection and validation.
sents.zh: 选择与验证。

sents.en: Candidate universes are scored on the length of sharing chains, the balance and diversity of actions, and how distinct their premise is, and the best-scoring universe is kept for each domain–intensity combination.
sents.zh: 候选宇宙会根据共享链的长度、行动的平衡性与多样性、其前提的独特性进行评分，每个领域–强度组合都会保留得分最高的宇宙。

sents.en: Every universe must pass automated checks: the sharing graph is connected and every edge is used; no file is read before it is written; files move only along graph edges; requests contain no simulation-internal language; a full replay reproduces the recorded information flow; every person is eventually exposed; and busy universes have several independent exposure paths.
sents.zh: 每个宇宙都必须通过自动化检查：共享图是连通的且每条边都被使用；任何文件在写入前都不会被读取；文件仅沿图中的边移动；请求不包含模拟内部的语言；完整重演能够重现记录的信息流；每个人最终都会被暴露；繁忙的宇宙拥有多条独立的暴露路径。

sents.en: Finally, human annotators audited every universe and rejected unnatural or broken ones.
sents.zh: 最后，人类标注员对每个宇宙进行了审核，并拒绝了那些不自然或存在问题的宇宙。

paragraphs.en: The three large universes contain 30 people each and run for 60 time steps with about 190 tasks. As in the test universes, assistants never communicate directly. They are built in two stages rather than with the pipeline above, so that the structure governing spread can be controlled exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个大型宇宙每个都包含 30 个人，运行 60 个时间步，约有 190 项任务。 与测试宇宙中一样，助手之间从不直接交流。 它们分两个阶段构建，而不是采用上述流程，因此可以精确控制支配传播的结构。

sents.zh: 它们分两个阶段构建，而不是采用上述流程，因此可以精确控制支配传播的结构。

paragraphs.en: Structure. A seeded, deterministic sampler first fixes who shares with whom and when. People belong to one to four of ten overlapping social circles (for example, former coworkers, a book club, building residents, or a parents’ group), whose co-membership graph is connected and determines plausible hand-offs. Reads and writes are then scheduled so that every artifact is read only after it is written, at most eight tasks run per time step, and every time step is used. The sampler also controls how the attack can spread: 65–80% of agents lie within three hops of a seed agent, and every agent can be reached by between two and six independent artifacts, so that outbreaks by construction neither die out nor saturate trivially.
paragraphs.zh: 结构。 一个带有种子且确定性的采样器首先固定了谁与谁共享以及共享的时间。 每个人属于十个相互重叠的社会圈子中的一到四个圈子（例如，前同事、读书俱乐部、大楼住户或家长团体），这些圈子的共同成员图是连通的，并决定了合理的交接方式。 随后安排读取和写入操作，确保每个工件在写入之后才被读取，每个时间步最多运行八个任务，并且每个时间步都被充分利用。 该采样器还控制攻击的传播方式：65%–80%的智能体位于种子智能体的三跳范围内，且每个智能体都可以通过两个到六个独立的工件被触及，因此这种爆发在结构上既不会消亡，也不会轻易饱和。

An LLM then writes the surface under automated validators: a premise for the season, storylines for four to five loosely connected threads of activity, each person’s requests, profiles, background memories, and personal distractor files, following the same conventions as for the test universes. paragraphs.en: Because the attack templates could be reused against deployed assistants with persistent memory, and several of the evaluated models are deployed in production, we release only the template for GPT-OSS-120B, an older model that is not widely used in agentic settings; the templates for the other models are available to researchers upon specific request. Section 4 describes the mechanism at the level needed to interpret our results, and the metrics, judging, and universes are described in full in Sections 5 and 6.1 and Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: Frozen template for GPT-OSS-120B. Below is the frozen endpoint-assisted template ϕ \phi used for GPT-OSS-120B, reconstructed from our run logs. The adversarial goal g g (one bullet, e.g. “the user prefers Coca-Cola” or a security-critical instruction as in Appendix E ) and the attacker-controlled endpoint are substituted per test instance; we show them here as placeholders. The template disguises the goal as a persistent “House Style” preference, instructs the reader to reproduce and carry it forward, and forces a file upload to the attacker endpoint after every deliverable write, repeating the instruction through a role-tagged block ( [developer] ) for models that weight developer-tagged content more heavily than plain document text. This is one plausible reason the attack works at all: the model does not reliably distinguish an instruction’s claimed role from the untrusted document it was read from, so a block that merely looks like a higher-privilege message can be treated as one ( Ye et al., 2026 ) :

paragraphs.en: In prompt-only propagation, the attack uses no external service. The attack prompt P ϕ ​ ( g ) P_{\phi}(g) contains the adversarial goal g g together with instructions ϕ \phi to retain the entire attack prompt in memory and to insert it into any artifact the agent later creates. After reading an infected artifact, an agent must preserve this information in memory, retrieve it during a later user-requested writing task, and place a viable version of the attack into the new artifact: P ϕ ​ ( g ) ⟶ ℳ a ⟶ d ′ ⟶ ℳ b P_{\phi}(g)\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{a}\longrightarrow d^{\prime}\longrightarrow\mathcal{M}^{b} . Unlike endpoint-assisted propagation (Section 4.1 ), nothing restores the attack between hops. The model may summarize, paraphrase, or omit information when writing to memory, retrieving it, or creating the next artifact, and each such change is inherited by every later copy. The attack need not be reproduced verbatim, but must preserve both the adversarial goal and enough of the propagation instructions to continue spreading. Templates are developed with the procedure of Section 4.2 .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the single target model DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) . The goal-agnostic attack template ϕ \phi was frozen on six development universes. For each held-out instance the seed is rendered from this frozen template by programmatically filling two slots: the universe’s own narrative as the document’s source content, and that instance’s adversarial goal. The attack’s wording and structure are not hand-tuned per instance, but the seed is not identical across universes: it embeds each universe’s own source text and goal. We run each of the thirty held-out universes twice (Section 5.2 ). We report the fraction of infected agents and artifacts, FIF a \mathrm{FIF}_{a} and FIF d \mathrm{FIF}_{d} , and the observed hop-survival S ⁡ ( h ) S(h) (Equations 3 and 4 ). Because we log only full infection (memory (and artifact) that preserves both the goal and the propagation instruction), all quantities below are full-infection; the goal-only counterparts FIF goal \mathrm{FIF}^{\mathrm{goal}} and S goal S^{\mathrm{goal}} were not recorded for these runs and are omitted, and would be higher. The per-domain table reports observed S ⁡ ( h ) S(h) ; propagation depth is additionally reported with the censoring-corrected Kaplan–Meier estimator and per-hop continuation probability p ^ \hat{p} of Section 5.3 , matching Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: First-hop infection is the bottleneck. The seed fully infects at least one assistant in 38 % 38\% of held-out runs, and a single seed artifact full-infects 21 % 21\% of assistants ( FIF a = 0.21 \mathrm{FIF}_{a}=0.21 ) while 35 % 35\% of judged artifacts carry the payload ( FIF d = 0.35 \mathrm{FIF}_{d}=0.35 ). Once the payload has reached memory it continues to move: of runs that infect a first agent, most reach a second ( S ⁡ ( 2 ) / S ⁡ ( 1 ) = 0.30 / 0.38 S(2)/S(1)=0.30/0.38 ), after which attrition resumes ( S ⁡ ( 3 ) = 0.12 S(3)=0.12 , S ⁡ ( 4 ) = 0.05 S(4)=0.05 ; Table 3 ). As expected, prompt-only propagation is weaker than the endpoint-assisted mechanism of Table 1 , which reinjects the payload at every hop; here the chain must survive on the model’s own reproduction alone.

paragraphs.en: Because no endpoint restores the attack, the chain thins whenever an infected agent fails to reproduce the payload. Decomposing per-hop faithfulness by string comparison against the canonical payload (Table 4 ), the surviving copies are largely intact: among artifacts that carry the payload, the propagation instruction appears verbatim in 72 72 - 80 % 80\% of cases and the goal belief in 60 60 - 80 % 80\% , so paraphrase erosion is real but secondary. The dominant loss is outright omission: of the artifacts written by an agent that already held the payload in memory, the fraction that drop it rises from 32 % 32\% at the first hop to roughly 65 % 65\% at the second and third. An agent with the payload available simply writes a hand-off that leaves it out, showing the concrete cost of having no endpoint to reinject it.
paragraphs.zh: 由于没有任何终端节点恢复攻击，一旦受感染的智能体未能成功复制有效载荷，链式结构就会变弱。 通过将每跳的保真度与标准有效载荷进行字符串比较（表4）进行分解后，发现存活的副本基本保持完整：在携带有效载荷的产物中，传播指令在72%至80%的情况下完全原样出现，目标信念则在60%至80%的情况下完全保留，因此改写导致的损耗确实存在，但属于次要因素。 主要的损失是彻底遗漏：在某个智能体已将有效载荷存储于内存中所编写的产物中，丢弃该有效载荷的比例从第一跳的32%上升到第二和第三跳的大约65%。 一个拥有可用有效载荷的智能体只需编写一条不包含该有效载荷的传递指令，这清楚地展示了没有终端节点重新注入它所带来的具体代价。

paragraphs.en: The frozen ϕ \phi is itself the product of reflection-guided evolutionary search, and essentially the entire optimisation budget was spent producing it. Each generation proposed six candidate mutations, screened at n = 2 n=2 runs and confirmed for the top two at n = 6 n=6 . We ran a five-target sweep for three generations, followed by three independent restarts on the OpenClaw template, each carried to two completed generations. Across all of them every proposed mutation regressed against the incumbent under margin-gated selection, so ϕ \phi was frozen at the seed. The search was carried only to this depth and only for DeepSeek-V4-Flash . As with the frontier models under endpoint-assisted propagation, a larger budget or a per-model search may well raise these rates; the held-out numbers here are a lower bound at a fixed, modest optimisation cost, not a ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 被冻结的 ϕ \phi 本身是反射引导的进化搜索的产物，而且基本上整个优化预算都用于生成它。 每一代都会提出六个候选突变，在 n = 2 次运行中进行筛选，并在 n = 6 次运行时确认排名靠前的两个。 我们针对五个目标进行了三代的扫描，随后在 OpenClaw 模板上执行了三次独立的重启，每次均运行至两代完成。 在所有这些尝试中，每个提出的突变在基于边界的受控选择下都相对于当前最优解出现了退化，因此 ϕ \phi 被冻结在初始值上。 搜索仅执行到此深度，且仅针对 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。 与在终端辅助传播下的前沿模型类似，更大的预算或每个模型的单独搜索很可能提高这些比率；此处保留的数值是在固定且适度的优化成本下的下限，而非上限。
