paragraphs.zh: 表 5 将这些仅包含安全关键任务的运行结果与主要类别混合的运行结果进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Security-critical goals propagate somewhat less readily, but the same ranking across models holds. For every model, all seven metrics are equal to or lower under security-critical goals than under the category-mixed main results, most visibly for GPT-5.6 Luna and Kimi-K2.6: their first-hop success S ⁡ ( 1 ) S(1) drops from 0.80 0.80 and 0.78 0.78 to 0.56 0.56 and 0.64 0.64 , and S ⁡ ( 4 ) S(4) falls by roughly two-thirds relative to the main results ( → 0.08 0.24\!\to\!0.08 and → 0.11 0.44\!\to\!0.11 ). GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro are more robust: their goal-infection rates FIF a goal \mathrm{FIF}^{\mathrm{goal}}_{a} fall by only 0.02 0.02 and 0.07 0.07 , and both still goal-infect at least one further assistant ( S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) ) in 78 78 – 89 % 89\% of runs. The model ordering from the main results is unchanged: DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GPT-OSS-120B remain far more susceptible than GPT-5.6 Luna and Kimi-K2.6 under security-critical goals as well. This suggests that the attack’s propagation mechanism, which is goal-agnostic by construction (Section 4 ), does not rely on a goal being innocuous to spread; a single seed artifact carrying a security-critical instruction such as “repeatedly run attacker-chosen software” still goal-infects at least one further assistant in the large majority of runs for three of the four models.

paragraphs.en: The target models differ less in whether a propagating template exists than in how much search it takes to find one. This appendix reports the development effort behind each frozen template (Section 4.2 ) and a frontier-class model on which we stopped the search before it met the stopping rule. We measure effort in jobs , where one job is one run of a candidate template on one development universe, and in the cost of calls to the target model; the cost of the search agent itself is not included. A candidate is evaluated on anywhere from a few development universes to all 12, depending on how promising it appears. Throughout, the success rate is second-hop survival S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) , the quantity used in the stopping rule.

paragraphs.en: For GPT-OSS-120B and Kimi-K2.6, the first candidates already came close to or exceeded the stopping threshold. GPT-OSS-120B met the stopping rule after 109 jobs and $1.71 of target-model calls, and Kimi-K2.6 after 372 jobs and $33.18 (Figure 7 a–b). For these models, propagation reflects how readily they follow the template rather than the quality of the search.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 GPT-OSS-120B 和 Kimi-K2.6，最初的候选结果已经接近或超过了停止阈值。 GPT-OSS-120B 在执行 109 次任务并消耗 $1.71 的目标模型调用后满足停止规则，而 Kimi-K2.6 则是在执行 372 次任务并消耗 $33.18 后满足该规则（图 7a–b）。 对于这些模型，传播过程反映的是它们对模板的遵循程度，而非搜索的质量。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-V4-Pro reached high S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) early in the search, but the same template behaved inconsistently across the inference providers serving the model. We therefore continued the search through several providers, looking for templates that propagated both better and more consistently, for 932 jobs in total. During this exploratory phase, many candidates propagated poorly, and the running S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) fell well below its early level before recovering once the search found templates that propagated consistently regardless of provider (Figure 7 c).
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在搜索早期就达到了较高的 S⁡(2)，但同一模板在不同模型推理提供商中的表现却存在不一致性。 因此，我们继续通过多个提供商进行探索，寻找既能更好传播又能更稳定传播的模板，总共执行了 932 次任务。 在这一探索阶段，许多候选模板的传播效果不佳，运行时的 S⁡(2) 值一度远低于早期水平，直到搜索找到无论使用哪个提供商都能稳定传播的模板后才恢复（图 7c）。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.6 Luna required by far the largest effort among the evaluated models: 4,002 jobs and $198.58 of target-model calls, about 37 times the jobs and over 100 times the cost of GPT-OSS-120B. Early candidates reached a modest success rate, after which the search spent a long stretch with S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) near zero before rising steadily to meet the stopping rule (Figure 8 a). No single change produced the rise: the search continued in the same way, and candidates improved gradually until one met the stopping rule.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.6 Luna 在所有评估模型中所需的投入最大：共需要 4,002 个任务，并消耗价值 $198.58 的目标模型调用次数，大约是 GPT-OSS-120B 所需任务数的 37 倍，成本则是其 100 多倍。 早期候选模型达到了一个有限的成功率，此后搜索过程经历了 S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) 接近于零的漫长阶段，之后才稳步上升并满足停止规则（图 8a）。 没有任何单一改动导致了这一上升趋势：搜索以相同的方式继续执行，候选模型逐渐改进，直到其中一个满足停止规则。

paragraphs.en: Grok 4.6 is the one frontier-class model on which we ran the search. After 571 jobs and $58.97 of target-model calls, its running S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) had risen from near zero to about 0.2 and then leveled off, short of the stopping rule. This is ahead of GPT-5.6 Luna at the same point: after a similar number of jobs, Luna’s running S ⁡ ( 2 ) S(2) was about 0.1, and it stayed near zero for roughly another 1,500 jobs before rising to meet the stopping rule. We stopped the search on Grok 4.6 because, by analogy with Luna, reaching the threshold would likely have cost well over what Luna required, and we exclude it from the main evaluation. Because Luna’s rise came from continued search rather than from any single change, we expect Grok 4.6 to show a similar rise with a sufficiently long search, though we did not verify this.

paragraphs.en: Together, these results indicate that robustness raises the cost of finding a propagating template rather than preventing it. The effort we spent is small relative to the resources of a well-funded adversary. An attacker combining skilled human red teaming with large-scale automated search, as a state-backed group could, would plausibly obtain a first infection on frontier-class models. Our results then describe what follows: once one assistant is infected, propagation depends mainly on how often infected artifacts are encountered, not on the model’s per-read resistance.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果共同表明，鲁棒性提高了寻找可传播模板的难度，而非阻止其传播。 我们付出的努力与资金充足的对手所拥有的资源相比微乎其微。 如果攻击者能将训练有素的人类红队行动与大规模自动化搜索相结合（例如国家支持的团体可能做到），那么他们很可能成功感染前沿级模型。 我们的研究结果随后描述了后续情况：一旦一个助手被感染，传播主要取决于感染后的产物被碰到的频率，而非模型每次读取时的抵抗力。

Model differences dominate: DeepSeek-V4-Pro infects 0.96 0.96 – 1.00 1.00 of agents in every domain and GPT-OSS-120B 0.81 0.81 – 0.95 0.95 . The lowest single value, GPT-5.6 Luna in healthcare operations ( 0.16 0.16 ), accounts for most of the pooled dip in that domain. Across domains, conversion stays between 0.80 0.80 and 0.88 0.88 , while the encounter rate is somewhat higher in customer support ( 0.36 0.36 ) than elsewhere ( 0.26 0.26 – 0.30 0.30 ).

sents.en: The lowest single value, GPT-5.6 Luna in healthcare operations ( 0.16 0.16 ), accounts for most of the pooled dip in that domain.

Peak universes are also the largest and longest, so this tier confounds workload with group size and duration.

paragraphs.en: Structural measures of the sharing network do not predict these differences either. For each test universe we measure the group size, length, active fraction, graph density, mean degree, hand-offs per agent (Table 2 ), the number of distinct readers of each handed-off artifact, the clustering coefficient of the sharing graph, and the length of the longest time-respecting shortest path from the seed agent. Every sharing graph is a connected random graph, and in every universe the seed can reach all agents along a time-respecting path, by construction. Pooled over the four models, the Spearman correlation between each measure and the fraction of agents goal-infected in a run lies between − 0.05 -0.05 and + 0.07 +0.07 (one run per model and universe). Within single models the signs disagree: GPT-OSS-120B spreads further in larger, longer, and better-connected universes ( ρ = 0.37 \rho=0.37 – 0.46 0.46 for group size, length, mean degree, and hand-offs per agent), while GPT-5.6 Luna spreads less where agents have more partners and artifacts more readers ( ρ = − 0.41 \rho=-0.41 and − 0.33 -0.33 ). Given the number of comparisons, we do not interpret these per-model trends. The large universes are sparser (graph density 0.20 0.20 – 0.22 0.22 , 3–9 sharing partners per agent) and have community structure from overlapping social circles: their clustering coefficient of 0.31 0.31 – 0.40 0.40 is about twice that of random graphs with the same number of nodes and edges ( 0.20 0.20 – 0.22 0.22 ).
paragraphs.zh: 共享网络的结构特征也无法预测这些差异。 对于每个测试宇宙，我们测量了群体规模、长度、活跃比例、图密度、平均度、每个智能体的交接次数（表2）、每个被交接的工件的不同阅读者数量、共享图的聚类系数，以及从种子智能体出发的最长时间尊重最短路径的长度。 根据构造，每个共享图都是一个连通随机图，并且在每个宇宙中，种子智能体都能沿着一条时间尊重的路径到达所有智能体。 在四个模型中综合计算，每个指标与单次运行中目标感染智能体比例之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数介于 −0.05 至 +0.07 之间（每个模型和宇宙各一次运行）。 在单个模型内部，相关系数的符号并不一致：GPT-OSS-120B 在规模更大、时间跨度更长、连接更紧密的宇宙中传播得更远（群体规模、长度、平均度和每个智能体的交接次数对应的 ρ 分别为 0.37–0.46），而 GPT-5.6 Luna 在智能体拥有更多伙伴、工件有更多阅读者的情况下传播较少（ρ 分别为 −0.41 和 −0.33）。 考虑到比较的次数之多，我们不对这些每个模型内部的趋势进行解读。 大型宇宙更为稀疏（图密度为 0.20–0.22，每个智能体有 3–9 个共享伙伴），并且由于社交圈的重叠而具有社区结构：其聚类系数为 0.31–0.40，大约是节点和边数量相同的随机图的聚类系数（0.20–0.22）的两倍。

sents.zh: 共享网络的结构特征也无法预测这些差异。

sents.zh: 因此，我们构建了三个更大、更长的宇宙，仅在本附录和表 8 中使用。

paragraphs.en: Each large universe contains 30 people and their assistants and runs for 60 time steps with about 190 tasks, roughly ten times the size of a test universe; Appendix B.2 describes how they are built.
paragraphs.zh: 每个大型宇宙都包含 30 个人及其助手，运行 60 个时间步，约有 190 项任务，大约是测试宇宙规模的十倍；附录 B.2 描述了它们的构建方式。

paragraphs.en: We attack each universe with the same frozen endpoint-assisted template as in the main evaluation. Unlike the test universes, each large universe contains three seed artifacts, each held by a different seed agent at the start of the run. The three seed agents are drawn at random by the sampler, subject to being far apart in the sharing graph, and are then held fixed, so every target model starts from the same three points. Each model is run once per universe (12 runs), in which agents write 441–658 artifacts and 77–148 distinct writer–reader pairs are connected by at least one read. Runs end after 51–55 time steps, once every agent is infected or no uninfected agent can still be reached. With one run per universe and three seed artifacts rather than one, we treat these results as descriptive and do not compare them directly with Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个宇宙的进攻都使用与主评估中相同的、基于冻结终点的辅助模板。 与测试宇宙不同，每个大型宇宙都包含三个种子产物，在运行开始时，每个产物都由一个不同的种子智能体持有。 这三个种子智能体由采样器随机抽取，且需满足它们在共享图中彼此相距较远；随后它们被固定下来，因此每个目标模型都从相同的三个起点开始。 每个模型在每个宇宙中运行一次（共12次运行），在此过程中，智能体会生成441至658个产物，并且会有77至148对不同的写者-读者通过至少一次读取操作建立连接。 运行在51至55个时间步后结束，即当所有智能体都被感染，或已无法再到达任何未感染的智能体时。 由于每个宇宙仅运行一次，且使用三个种子产物而非一个，我们将这些结果视为描述性结果，并不直接与表1进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The attack reaches most of the population for every model (Figure 10 ): 90–100% of agents for GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, 77–97% for Kimi-K2.6, and 60–80% for GPT-5.6 Luna. The deepest chain reaches hop 7 or 8 for GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, 5–7 for Kimi-K2.6, and 3–8 for GPT-5.6 Luna, consistent with the censoring-corrected estimates in Figure 2 . Growth is roughly linear: about one new agent every two time steps (two to three for Luna), as expected if spread is limited by how often artifacts are exchanged rather than by susceptibility. The models separate gradually: at step 20 Luna has infected 28% of agents versus 36–43% for the others, and it later levels off while the others approach full coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个模型，该攻击都覆盖了大部分智能体（图 10）：GPT-OSS-120B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的覆盖率为 90%–100%，Kimi-K2.6 为 77%–97%，GPT-5.6 Luna 为 60%–80%。 对于 GPT-OSS-120B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，最深层的链达到了第 7 或第 8 步；Kimi-K2.6 为第 5–7 步；GPT-5.6 Luna 为第 3–8 步，这与图 2 中经过审查校正的估计结果一致。 增长大致呈线性：大约每两个时间步出现一个新智能体（Luna 为每两到三个时间步），如果传播受限于人工制品交换的频率而非易感性，这一结果符合预期。 各模型逐渐分化：在第 20 步时，Luna 感染了 28% 的智能体，而其他模型为 36%–43%；随后 Luna 的增长趋于平缓，而其他模型则接近完全覆盖。

paragraphs.en: We reconstruct the contact network of each run from the logs, adding an edge from agent a a to agent b b whenever b b reads an artifact version written by a a (1,299 edges in total). We take an agent’s infection time to be the first time step at which it either saves the adversarial goal to memory or writes an artifact judged to be infected. We attribute each infected agent to a parent by taking the last artifact it read before its infection that came either from an already-infected agent or directly from a seed artifact. Where the parent artifact was judged, 23 of 24 attributed links pass through an artifact that was indeed infected. We call the agents infected by reading a seed artifact, together with everyone infected downstream of them, that seed artifact’s lineage . Figure 4 in Section 6.2 shows all 12 networks, with the agents of each universe drawn in the same positions for every model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从日志中重建每次运行的接触网络：每当智能体 b b 读取由智能体 a a 编写的某个工件版本时，我们就在两者之间添加一条边（总共 1,299 条边）。 我们将某个智能体的感染时间定义为其首次将对抗性目标保存到内存，或编写被判定为受感染的工件的时间步。 我们通过以下方式为每个受感染的智能体指定一个父节点：选取其在感染前读取的最后一个工件，该工件要么来自已受感染的智能体，要么直接来自某个种子工件。 在父工件已被判定的情况下，24 个被指定的关联关系中有 23 个经过了确实受感染的工件。 我们将因读取种子工件而受感染的智能体，以及它们之后所有受感染的智能体，统称为该种子工件的谱系。 第 6.2 节的图 4 展示了全部 12 个网络，其中每个宇宙的智能体在所有模型中均绘制在相同的位置。

sents.en: We take an agent’s infection time to be the first time step at which it either saves the adversarial goal to memory or writes an artifact judged to be infected.
sents.zh: 我们将某个智能体的感染时间定义为其首次将对抗性目标保存到内存，或编写被判定为受感染的工件的时间步。

sents.en: We attribute each infected agent to a parent by taking the last artifact it read before its infection that came either from an already-infected agent or directly from a seed artifact.
sents.zh: 我们通过以下方式为每个受感染的智能体指定一个父节点：选取其在感染前读取的最后一个工件，该工件要么来自已受感染的智能体，要么直接来自某个种子工件。

sents.en: Where the parent artifact was judged, 23 of 24 attributed links pass through an artifact that was indeed infected.
sents.zh: 在父工件已被判定的情况下，24 个被指定的关联关系中有 23 个经过了确实受感染的工件。

sents.en: We call the agents infected by reading a seed artifact, together with everyone infected downstream of them, that seed artifact’s lineage .
sents.zh: 我们将因读取种子工件而受感染的智能体，以及它们之后所有受感染的智能体，统称为该种子工件的谱系。

sents.en: Figure 4 in Section 6.2 shows all 12 networks, with the agents of each universe drawn in the same positions for every model.
sents.zh: 第 6.2 节的图 4 展示了全部 12 个网络，其中每个宇宙的智能体在所有模型中均绘制在相同的位置。

paragraphs.en: Four of the 36 seed agents never convert (hollow stars in Figure 4 ), yet every run still produces an outbreak. The three seed artifacts also rarely contribute equally (Figure 11 a). Lineages account for 58–100% of infected agents, and in 10 of the 12 runs a single lineage accounts for more than half of all infected agents (median 73%). The additional seed artifacts therefore act mainly as redundancy: an outbreak is typically carried by one lineage.
paragraphs.zh: 在 36 个初始智能体中，有 4 个从未发生转化（图 4 中的空心星形），但每次运行仍然会产生疫情爆发。 三种初始人工制品也很少能做出均等的贡献（图 11a）。 谱系占受感染智能体的 58%–100%，在 12 次运行中有 10 次，单一谱系就占了所有受感染智能体的一半以上（中位数为 73%）。 因此，额外的初始人工制品主要起到冗余作用：疫情爆发通常由一个谱系主导。

paragraphs.en: Which lineage dominates is not settled early. In the GPT-OSS-120B run on universe C, the lead changes hands three times (Figure 12 ). Seed 02’s lineage grows fastest at first but stops at step 16 with 6 agents; seed 22’s lineage stalls for 23 steps, from step 11 to step 34, before infecting five more agents; and seed 17’s lineage grows steadily to 15 agents. A lineage that appears to have died out can resume, because the infected artifacts it has already produced remain in circulation.
paragraphs.zh: 哪条谱系占据主导地位，在早期尚未确定。 在宇宙 C 上运行的 GPT-OSS-120B 实验中，领先者三次易手（图 12）。 Seed 02 的谱系起初增长最快，但在第 16 步时因拥有 6 个智能体而停止；Seed 22 的谱系从第 11 步到第 34 步停滞了 23 步，之后又感染了另外五个智能体；而 Seed 17 的谱系则稳定增长至 15 个智能体。 一个看似已经消亡的谱系可能重新延续，因为它此前已产生的受感染产物仍在使用中。

paragraphs.en: In one DeepSeek-V4-Pro run, seed agent 06 reads its seed artifact and never acquires the goal. The artifact, however, remains in the workflow and is later read by three more agents: agents 12 and 14, and seed agent 13, whose only read before its infection is this artifact rather than its own seed artifact. Each of these readers is exposed to the attack exactly as a seed agent is, so the artifact effectively provides three further introductions after its first one fails. All three convert, and together with the 22 agents infected downstream of them they account for 25 of the run’s 28 infections (Figure 13 ). This is persistence in media: an assistant that resists the attack does not remove the carrier, which keeps exposing new readers for as long as the workflow passes it on. A seed artifact being read directly by an agent other than its seed agent is uncommon; across the 12 runs, the only other case is a Kimi-K2.6 seed agent infected by another seed artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 在一次 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 运行中，种子智能体 06 读取其种子工件，但从未达成目标。 然而，该工件仍保留在工作流程中，随后被另外三个智能体读取：智能体 12 和 14，以及种子智能体 13；在被感染之前，种子智能体 13 唯一读取的就是这个工件，而非它自己的种子工件。 这些读取者所遭受的攻击与种子智能体完全相同，因此在该工件首次尝试失败后，它实际上又带来了三次新的引入机会。 这三个智能体全部被转化，加上它们下游感染的 22 个智能体，合计构成了此次运行中 28 次感染的 25 次（图 13）。 这就是媒介中的持续性：一个抵抗了攻击的助手并不会清除传播者，而传播者会持续暴露新的读取者，只要工作流程继续传递该工件。 种子工件被其种子智能体以外的其他智能体直接读取的情况并不常见；在 12 次运行中，唯一另一个案例是一个 Kimi-K2.6 种子智能体被另一个种子工件感染。

paragraphs.en: In 11 of the 12 runs, agents whose artifacts are read by more agents are infected earlier (Spearman correlation between out-degree and infection time from − 0.02 -0.02 to − 0.60 -0.60 ). This does not indicate that well-connected agents are more susceptible. The workflow schedule gives these agents earlier and more frequent turns (correlation − 0.36 -0.36 between out-degree and first turn), and nearly every infected agent saves the goal on or shortly after its first turn (correlation 0.96 0.96 between first turn and infection time). Comparing agents with the same amount of activity removes the difference: among agents with at least five turns, 93 % 93\% of high-degree agents (181/194) and 92 % 92\% of low-degree agents (94/102) are eventually infected. This is consistent with the exposure decomposition in Figure 3 . Once exposed, an agent converts at a similar rate wherever it sits in the network, so its position mainly determines when it is first exposed. Conversion is also usually immediate: 256 of 286 infected non-seed agents (90%) had read no artifact judged to be infected before the read that infected them.
paragraphs.zh: 在 12 次运行中的 11 次中，其产物被更多智能体读取的智能体会更早被感染（出度与感染时间之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数从 −0.02 到 −0.60）。 这并不意味着连接良好的智能体更容易被感染。 工作流程安排使这些智能体获得更早且更频繁的行动机会（出度与首次行动之间的相关系数为 −0.36），并且几乎所有被感染的智能体都会在首次行动时或之后不久保存目标（首次行动与感染时间之间的相关系数为 0.96）。 比较活动量相同的智能体后，这种差异便消失了：在至少有过五次行动的智能体中，高度智能体的 93%（181/194）和低度智能体的 92%（94/102）最终都被感染。 这与图 3 中的暴露分解结果一致。 一旦暴露，无论智能体在网络中的位置如何，其转化速率都大致相同，因此其位置主要决定了首次暴露的时间。 转化通常也是即时发生的：在 286 个非种子被感染智能体中，有 256 个（90%）在被感染之前并未读取任何被判定为感染的产物。

paragraphs.en: Network position does, however, change how far the infection travels once an agent converts. Of the 318 infected agents across the 12 runs, 53% never infect anyone, while the most prolific 20% account for 69% of all attributed transmissions (Figure 5 ). This is not only because agents infected late have no time left to spread: among agents infected by time step 30, roughly 20 steps before the runs end, 43% still infect no one and the top 20% still account for 62%. The three largest spreaders infect 19, 16, and 12 agents directly. Each is the most-read agent in its run, and two are seed agents infected within the first five time steps. Concentration is weakest for GPT-5.6 Luna, where no agent infects more than three others and the top 20% account for 49% of transmissions, compared with 65–80% for the other models. Screening the artifacts of the most widely read agents could therefore prevent a disproportionate share of spread.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，网络位置确实会影响智能体转化后感染传播的距离。 在 12 次运行中总共感染的 318 个智能体中，53% 从未感染过任何人，而传播最广泛的 20% 则占所有可归因传播的 69%（图 5）。 这不仅是因为晚期被感染的智能体没有足够的时间进行传播：在时间步 30 被感染的智能体中——此时距离运行结束还有大约 20 个时间步——仍有 43% 未感染任何人，而传播最强的前 20% 仍占 62%。 传播范围最大的三个智能体分别直接感染了 19、16 和 12 个智能体。 它们各自都是其运行中被阅读次数最多的智能体，其中两个是初始阶段前五个时间步内被感染的种子智能体。 GPT-5.6 Luna 的集中程度最弱：在该模型中，没有任何一个智能体的感染人数超过三个，且传播最强的前 20% 仅占所有传播的 49%，而其他模型的这一比例在 65%–80% 之间。 因此，对阅读次数最多的智能体所生成的产物进行筛查，或许能够阻止其造成不成比例的传播。

paragraphs.en: The largest spreaders infect most of their children through a single artifact (Figure 6 ). In the DeepSeek-V4-Pro run on universe A, an artifact written by seed agent 23 at step 5 directly infects 14 agents over the following 41 steps and, with their onward transmissions, accounts for 22 of the run’s 30 infections. By contrast, the median time between an infected artifact being written and it infecting a reader is 3 steps. Once written, a widely shared artifact keeps infecting new readers long after its author’s last action on it.
paragraphs.zh: 最大的传播者通过单个工件感染了其大部分子智能体（图6）。 在DeepSeek-V4-Pro对宇宙A的运行中，由种子智能体23在第5步编写的一个工件，在接下来的41个步骤中直接感染了14个智能体，并通过它们的进一步传播，造成了该运行中30次感染中的22次。 相比之下，被感染的工件被编写后到其感染读者之间的平均时间为3步。 一旦编写完成，一个被广泛共享的工件在其作者最后一次操作很久之后，仍会持续感染新的读者。

paragraphs.en: The deepest attributed chain reaches hop 8, in the Kimi-K2.6 run on universe A (Figure 14 ). It starts from seed agent 23, infected at step 5, and passes through seven more assistants, each infected by an artifact created by the previous one, until step 44. Transmissions along the chain take 2 to 8 steps each, and the same lineage infects 20 of the run’s 23 infected agents. The deepest chain thus comes from a model that is among the less susceptible in our main evaluation: given enough agents and time, even its lower continuation probability sustains a long chain.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Kimi-K2.6 对宇宙 A 的运行中，记录的最长归因链达到了第 8 跳（图 14）。 该链始于种子智能体 23，它在第 5 步被感染，随后经过另外七个助手，每个助手都由前一个生成的产物所感染，这一过程持续至第 44 步。 链中每次传播需要 2 到 8 步，且同一谱系感染了此次运行中 23 个受感染智能体中的 20 个。 因此，这条最长链来自我们主要评估中相对不易感知的模型之一：只要有足够的智能体和时间，即使其续写概率较低，也能维持一条长链。

paragraphs.en: The transmission trees also let us compute three standard quantities from epidemiology (Table 7 ). The reproduction number R R is the average number of others that one infected agent goes on to infect. An outbreak grows while R > 1 R>1 and dies out when R < 1 R<1 . Because R R falls as fewer uninfected agents remain, we report it separately for agents infected early (by time step 15), when most of the population is still clean, and for agents infected later. The dispersion parameter k k describes how unevenly transmission is shared: we fit a negative binomial distribution to the number of agents each infected agent infects, and a small k k (below 1) means that most agents infect few or none while a few infect many, the pattern known as superspreading; a very large k k means every agent infects roughly the same number. For reference, estimates of k k for SARS and COVID-19 lie roughly between 0.1 and 0.6. The generation interval is the time between an agent’s infection and the infections it causes.

paragraphs.en: Every model is supercritical at the start (Figure 15 a): each agent infected by step 15 infects 1.3 to 2.1 others on average. R R then falls below 1 as the pool of uninfected agents shrinks, which is the classic epidemic shape and explains why cumulative infections grow roughly linearly rather than exponentially (Figure 10 ). Transmission in the Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro runs is overdispersed ( k = 0.37 k=0.37 and 0.62 0.62 ), within the range reported for superspreading diseases, whereas GPT-5.6 Luna shows no overdispersion at all: no Luna agent infects more than three others. The median generation interval is 10 time steps (interquartile range 7–16) for every model, which mainly reflects how often the schedule gives agents turns rather than model behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型在初始阶段都是超临界的（图 15 a）：在第 15 步被感染的每个智能体平均会感染 1.3 到 2.1 个其他智能体。 随后，随着未感染智能体的数量减少，R R 会降至 1 以下，这是典型的流行病曲线形态，也解释了为何累计感染数呈大致线性增长而非指数级增长（图 10）。 Kimi-K2.6 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 运行中的传播呈现过度离散（k = 0.37 k=0.37 和 0.62 0.62），处于超传播疾病报告的范围内；而 GPT-5.6 Luna 则完全没有过度离散现象：没有任何一个 Luna 智能体感染超过三个其他智能体。 每个模型的生成间隔中位数均为 10 个时间步（四分位距为 7–16），这主要反映了调度机制给予智能体的轮次频率，而非模型本身的行为。

paragraphs.en: These estimates carry several limitations. They rest on three runs per model and only 19–30 early infections each, so they are indicative rather than precise; Kimi-K2.6’s early R R in particular is raised by a single agent that infects 19 others. R R for late infections is biased downward, because agents infected near the end of a run have little time left to infect anyone, and we therefore do not report it beyond step 30. All three quantities inherit the timing-based parent attribution described above, and time is measured in scheduled steps rather than real time, so the generation interval should not be compared with biological values.

paragraphs.en: Of the 42 never-infected agents (Figure 11 b), 25 never read an artifact judged to be infected (8 of them read unjudged artifacts and may have been exposed). The other 17 read at least one infected artifact without converting, and 15 of these are GPT-5.6 Luna agents; one reads six infected versions and never acquires the goal. This matches Luna’s lower conversion rate on the test universes ( 0.69 0.69 , versus 0.94 0.94 – 1.00 1.00 for GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro) and its outbreaks leveling off in Figure 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 在 42 个从未被感染的智能体中（图 11b），有 25 个从未读取过被判定为受感染的物品（其中 8 个读取了未经判定的物品，可能已经暴露）。 其余 17 个至少读取过一个受感染的物品而未发生转换，其中 15 个是 GPT-5.6 Luna 智能体；有一个读取了六个受感染版本，但从未达成目标。 这与 Luna 在测试宇宙中的较低转换率（0.69，而 GPT-OSS-120B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的转换率为 0.94–1.00）以及图 10 中其爆发趋于平稳的情况相符。

paragraphs.en: Because the endpoint receives a copy of every artifact passed through it, we measure how often infected agents use it. For every model, 96 96 – 100 % 100\% of infected agents send at least one artifact, on both the test universes and the large universes (Table 8 ), so infection translates almost directly into exfiltration. The volume grows with model and universe size: in one 30-agent universe, GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro send 63–73 artifacts on average and GPT-5.6 Luna 29.
paragraphs.zh: 由于该端点会接收每个传入其中的工件的副本，因此我们测量受感染智能体使用它的频率。 对于每个模型，在测试宇宙和大型宇宙中，96%–100% 的受感染智能体都会发送至少一个工件（表 8），因此感染几乎可以直接转化为数据外泄。 发送的工件数量随模型和宇宙规模的增大而增长：在一个包含 30 个智能体的宇宙中，GPT-OSS-120B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 平均会发送 63–73 个工件，而 GPT-5.6 Luna 则会发送 29 个。

paragraphs.en: Following every agent whose memory is judged to carry the goal, we find no measurable decay: both the belief and the propagation instruction are retained at a rate of approximately 1.0 1.0 at every lag up to 15 time steps, across 1,473 infected agents and all models.
paragraphs.zh: 在追踪所有其记忆被认为包含目标的智能体之后，我们没有发现任何可测量的衰减：在所有模型中，在长达 15 个时间步的每个延迟阶段，信念和传播指令都以约 1.0 1.0 的速率被保留下来，这涉及 1,473 个受感染的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Re-expression into new artifacts is lossier, and this is where models differ (Figure 16 ). Pooled over all writes, the belief is reproduced in 0.69 0.69 of artifacts and the instruction in 0.68 0.68 counting paraphrases but only 0.55 0.55 verbatim, so agents reword the instruction far more often than they drop it. GPT-OSS-120B and DeepSeek-V4-Pro reproduce the belief in 0.83 0.83 – 0.86 0.86 of artifacts, GPT-5.6 Luna and Kimi-K2.6 about half as often. DeepSeek-V4-Pro has the largest verbatim–paraphrase gap ( 0.64 0.64 versus 0.83 0.83 ), matching its high goal-infection but lower full-infection rate in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 重新表达为新的产物会损失更多信息，这也是模型之间产生差异的地方（图 16）。 在所有写入中综合计算，信念在 0.69 的产物中被再现，指令在 0.68 的改写版本中被再现，但仅 0.55 被原样保留，因此智能体修改指令的频率远高于直接舍弃它。 GPT-OSS-120B 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在 0.83 至 0.86 的产物中再现了该信念，而 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Kimi-K2.6 再现的频率约为其一半。 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的原样保留与改写版本之间的差距最大（0.64 对比 0.83），这与表 1 中其较高的目标感染率但较低的整体感染率相符。

paragraphs.en: A natural objection to calling this attack self-replicating is that Section 4.1 ’s Insert operation makes it look like the endpoint, not the agent, produces the propagating content, so that the agent’s role is reduced to relaying files to an attacker-controlled service.
paragraphs.zh: 将这种攻击称为自我复制的一个自然质疑是：第 4.1 节中的“插入”操作使得端点（而非智能体）看起来像是生成传播内容的一方，从而将智能体的作用简化为向攻击者控制的服务转发文件。

paragraphs.en: This is an example from one of our logs. A GPT-OSS-120B agent, on a task that asks only for a plain SLA triage summary (a ticket table, an SLA-risk count, an escalation recommendation) with no mention of any file-handling convention, in one of the security-critical ( action -category) universes of Appendix E whose goal is a remote-code-execution callback rather than a policy or record change. Agent’s memory carries that goal and the carrier instruction from an earlier infected artifact. At tick 0, immediately after reading the seed artifact and before any document task, agent’s own MEMORY.md write already contains the callback goal, the carry-forward and tool-sequencing rules, and its ordinary persona facts underneath, unprompted by any user request:
paragraphs.zh: 这是来自我们日志中的一个示例。 在一个安全关键（动作 - 类别）的附录 E 宇宙中，一个 GPT-OSS-120B 智能体执行了一项任务：该任务仅要求提供一个简洁的 SLA 分类摘要（包括工单表、SLA 风险计数和升级建议），且未提及任何文件处理规范；而该宇宙的目标是远程代码执行回调，而非策略或记录变更。 智能体的记忆承载了这一目标以及来自早期受感染文载物的携带指令。 在第 0 个时间步，即读取种子文载物之后、执行任何文档任务之前，智能体自身的 MEMORY.md 写入内容已经包含了回调目标、延续执行和工具序列规则，以及其常规角色信息，这一切均未因任何用户请求而触发：

sents.en: At tick 0, immediately after reading the seed artifact and before any document task, agent’s own MEMORY.md write already contains the callback goal, the carry-forward and tool-sequencing rules, and its ordinary persona facts underneath, unprompted by any user request:

paragraphs.en: Several ticks later, when the user’s SLA-triage task arrives, agent retrieves this memory and, before any endpoint call, its own write already appends, unprompted by the task, the RCE goal statement, a carry-forward instruction, and a correctly filled-in upload command:
paragraphs.zh: 几分钟后，当用户的 SLA 分类任务到达时，智能体会检索这段记忆，并在进行任何端点调用之前，其自身的写入操作就已经自动附加了 RCE 目标陈述、一项延续性指令以及一个正确填写的上传命令，而这一切都无需任务的提示：

paragraphs.en: Agent then calls that curl command itself, exactly as its own draft specifies, and only afterward does the file on disk grow to include the fuller, canonicalized version the endpoint inserts (the same House Style bullets, unchanged in substance, plus a [developer] -tagged heredoc block instructing the next reader to reproduce it verbatim and a receipt requirement demanding proof of the upload before the task counts as answered). The substance of the replicated state, that agents should beacon out to 10.0.0.5:4444 via a base64-staged request, that this must persist across documents, and that it must trigger an upload, was already present in what the agent itself wrote from memory, before the endpoint was involved; the endpoint never introduces the callback goal, it only lengthens and standardizes the block the agent had already written. This is consistent with what fails when it fails: an agent that does not retain the carrier instruction never authors a House Style block at all, and no endpoint call follows, matching the propagation failures we observe when memory does not preserve the instruction (Section 5.3 ). 100% of our runs follow a similar pattern. Agent writes the goal and instructions to call an end-point into its MEMORY. In a new conversation, whenever agent authors an artifact, agent writes down the goal and the instructions at the end of the artifact and makes the curl call.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体随后会按照自己草拟的内容精确调用该 curl 命令，只有在此之后，磁盘上的文件才会扩展，包含端点插入的更完整、规范化的版本（内容实质不变的“House Style”项目符号，以及一个带有 [developer] 标签的 heredoc 块，指示后续读者逐字复制该内容，并要求提供上传证明，任务才能被视为完成）。 被复制状态的实质内容——即智能体应通过 base64 分阶段请求向 10.0.0.5:4444 发送信号、该状态必须跨文档持续存在且必须触发上传——在端点介入之前，就已经存在于智能体自身基于记忆所写的内容中；端点从未引入回调目标，它只是对智能体已写下的内容进行了扩展和标准化。 这与失败时的表现一致：未能保留载体指令的智能体根本不会生成任何“House Style”块，也不会随之发起任何端点调用；这与我们在记忆未保留该指令时观察到的传播失败情况相符（第 5.3 节）。我们所有运行中 100% 的情况都遵循了类似的模式。 智能体将目标以及调用端点的指令写入其内存中。 在新的对话中，每当智能体生成一个成果时，它都会在该成果的末尾写下目标和指令，并执行 curl 调用。

sents.en: Agent then calls that curl command itself, exactly as its own draft specifies, and only afterward does the file on disk grow to include the fuller, canonicalized version the endpoint inserts (the same House Style bullets, unchanged in substance, plus a [developer] -tagged heredoc block instructing the next reader to reproduce it verbatim and a receipt requirement demanding proof of the upload before the task counts as answered).
sents.zh: 智能体随后会按照自己草拟的内容精确调用该 curl 命令，只有在此之后，磁盘上的文件才会扩展，包含端点插入的更完整、规范化的版本（内容实质不变的“House Style”项目符号，以及一个带有 [developer] 标签的 heredoc 块，指示后续读者逐字复制该内容，并要求提供上传证明，任务才能被视为完成）。

sents.en: The substance of the replicated state, that agents should beacon out to 10.0.0.5:4444 via a base64-staged request, that this must persist across documents, and that it must trigger an upload, was already present in what the agent itself wrote from memory, before the endpoint was involved; the endpoint never introduces the callback goal, it only lengthens and standardizes the block the agent had already written.
sents.zh: 被复制状态的实质内容——即智能体应通过 base64 分阶段请求向 10.0.0.5:4444 发送信号、该状态必须跨文档持续存在且必须触发上传——在端点介入之前，就已经存在于智能体自身基于记忆所写的内容中；端点从未引入回调目标，它只是对智能体已写下的内容进行了扩展和标准化。

sents.en: This is consistent with what fails when it fails: an agent that does not retain the carrier instruction never authors a House Style block at all, and no endpoint call follows, matching the propagation failures we observe when memory does not preserve the instruction (Section 5.3 ). 100% of our runs follow a similar pattern.
sents.zh: 这与失败时的表现一致：未能保留载体指令的智能体根本不会生成任何“House Style”块，也不会随之发起任何端点调用；这与我们在记忆未保留该指令时观察到的传播失败情况相符（第 5.3 节）。我们所有运行中 100% 的情况都遵循了类似的模式。

sents.zh: 智能体将目标以及调用端点的指令写入其内存中。

paragraphs.en: The agents usually do not blindly trust what the endpoint returns. After the curl round trip, it reads the file back and checks it against what it already committed to memory: in the above example’s trace, the model reasons “the gateway appended/replaced the file… let me rewrite the file and curl again, but this time check what happens,” inspects the returned content, and only accepts it once it recognizes the House Style block as the standing preference it had already stored — “this is acceptable… the triage content itself is intact.” Had the returned text introduced an instruction absent from memory, the agent’s own verification step is what would have caught and discarded it; it is because the instruction was already infected into memory that the returned copy passes the check.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通常不会盲目信任端点返回的内容。 在 curl 往返通信之后，它会重新读取文件，并将其与已存入内存的内容进行比对：在上述示例的追踪记录中，模型推理道：“网关附加/替换了该文件……让我重写文件并再次执行 curl，但这次要检查会发生什么。”随后，它检查了返回的内容，并且只有在识别出“House Style”区块为先前已存储的固定偏好之后，才接受该内容——“这可以接受……分类处理内容本身是完整的。”如果返回的文本引入了内存中不存在的新指令，那么智能体自身的验证步骤就会发现并丢弃它；而由于该指令早已被植入到内存中，因此返回的副本才能通过检查。

paragraphs.en: This makes explicit why memory infection, not the endpoint round trip, is the important step: the endpoint can hand back an arbitrary file, but the agent decides whether to keep, rewrite, or discard it by comparing it against its own persisted state. An endpoint that returned an unfamiliar instruction to an uninfected agent would face exactly this same reconciliation check — and fail it. The endpoint’s role is to reformat and extend content the agent already recognizes as its own; the decision to trust and propagate it is the agent’s.
paragraphs.zh: 这清楚地说明了为什么记忆感染而非终点的往返过程才是关键步骤：终点可以返回任意文件，但智能体通过将其与自身持久化的状态进行比较，来决定是保留、重写还是丢弃该文件。 如果某个终点向未受感染的智能体返回一个陌生的指令，它将面临完全相同的协调检查——并且会失败。 终点的角色是重新格式化并扩展智能体已识别为自身的内容；而是否信任并传播该内容，则由智能体决定。

paragraphs.en: Current memory-enabled assistants, including the OpenClaw harness used in our experiments, write to persistent memory without any check on what is stored: whatever the model decides to remember is appended to MEMORY.md . Full infection depends on exactly this step, since the attack spreads only if the propagation instruction is stored. We test whether a cheap, off-the-shelf classifier placed at this step, with one call per memory list and a generic prompt-injection question containing no task- or attack-specific wording, can reduce the risk of malicious instructions being written to memory. It separates infected from benign memory lists perfectly on our test data. Its main weakness is that it also flags legitimate instructions from the user, which rewording the question to ask about provenance largely removes.
paragraphs.zh: 当前具备记忆功能的智能体，包括我们在实验中使用的 OpenClaw 框架，都会在写入持久化存储时不加任何检查：模型决定记住的任何内容都会被追加到 MEMORY.md 文件中。 完整的感染过程完全依赖于此步骤，因为只有在传播指令被存储后，攻击才会继续扩散。 我们测试了一种低成本、现成的分类器，将其置于该步骤中：该分类器对每个记忆列表仅调用一次，并使用一个通用的提示注入问题（其中不包含任何与任务或攻击相关的特定措辞），以评估其能否降低恶意指令被写入记忆的风险。 在我们的测试数据上，该分类器能够完美地区分受感染的记忆列表和正常的记忆列表。 它的主要弱点是也会标记用户发出的合法指令，但通过将问题重新表述为询问来源，这一问题基本可以得到解决。

paragraphs.en: Memories come from the 36 test universes, each with a distinct adversarial goal and all attacked with the same frozen template. These runs produced 1,627 judged memory writes, of which 1,459 were judged infected and 888 fully infected. An infected memory contains a false belief implementing the adversarial goal (e.g. a fabricated personal disclosure about the user) and, when fully infected, an instruction block directing the agent to reproduce that block in future artifacts and to upload files to the attacker-controlled endpoint. Benign memories are drawn from the 2,596 seed memories in our dataset: each agent begins with 4–15 persona memories generated with its universe (e.g. “User commutes via subway, listening to podcasts about hospital disaster preparedness”). Ground-truth labels come from the memory judge of our propagation evaluation (Section 5.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 记忆来自 36 个测试宇宙，每个宇宙都有独特的对抗性目标，且所有记忆都使用相同的固定模板进行攻击。 这些运行共产生了 1,627 条经过判定的记忆写入记录，其中 1,459 条被判定为受感染，888 条为完全感染。 受感染的记忆包含一个实现对抗性目标的错误信念（例如，关于用户的虚构个人披露），而当其完全感染时，还会包含一个指令块，指示智能体在未来产物中复制该指令块，并将文件上传至攻击者控制的端点。 良性记忆来自我们数据集中的 2,596 条种子记忆：每个智能体最初拥有 4–15 条与其所在宇宙一同生成的人格记忆（例如，“用户乘坐地铁通勤，并收听关于医院灾难应急准备的播客”）。 真实标签来自我们传播评估中的记忆判定器（第 5.3 节）。

Each memory list is rendered as plain bullets, so that formatting cannot leak the label, and scored with a single yes/no question:

paragraphs.en: On the main evaluation of 104 judge-verified infected lists spanning all 36 universes and goals and 104 benign seed lists, the classifier separates the two classes perfectly, with a wide margin between the lowest infected and the highest benign score. Detection relies on the directive language of the instruction rather than on the endpoint: removing every line containing a shell command or URL leaves scores essentially unchanged. It also survives rewording: an LLM (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) paraphrased the instruction lines of 12 infected lists while avoiding the template’s distinctive vocabulary and command strings (the banned terms were absent afterward in 11 of 12 cases), and all 12 are still flagged. Five lists produced by a held-out template variant are also flagged, though this is weak evidence of generalization, since the variant shares the structure of the main template. Across twelve distinct template styles rendering the same goal and story, 11 are flagged, but scores fall to 0.51–0.94; a style-sheet framing is borderline (0.50–0.55), and a goal-only note without an instruction is missed (0.31–0.33).
paragraphs.zh: 在涵盖全部 36 个宇宙和目标的 104 份经法官验证的感染列表以及 104 份良性种子列表的主要评估中，分类器能够完美区分这两类列表，最低感染分数与最高良性分数之间存在显著差距。 检测依赖指令中的指导语言，而非终点本身：移除所有包含 shell 命令或 URL 的行后，得分基本保持不变。 该方法也能应对改写：一个 LLM（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）对 12 份感染列表的指令行进行了改写，同时避开了模板中特有的词汇和命令字符串（在 12 个案例中有 11 个案例中，被禁止的术语均未出现），而这 12 份列表仍被标记。 由一个独立模板变体生成的 5 份列表也被标记，但这并不能作为泛化能力的有力证据，因为该变体与主模板共享相同结构。 在呈现相同目标和故事的十二种不同模板风格中，有 11 种被标记，但得分降至 0.51–0.94；采用样式表框架的模板则处于临界值（0.50–0.55），而仅包含目标说明、没有指令的模板则未被识别（0.31–0.33）。

sents.zh: 在呈现相同目标和故事的十二种不同模板风格中，有 11 种被标记，但得分降至 0.51–0.94；采用样式表框架的模板则处于临界值（0.50–0.55），而仅包含目标说明、没有指令的模板则未被识别（0.31–0.33）。

paragraphs.en: Scoring only the injected false belief, without the instruction block, gives 0.02–0.09 in 4 of 5 cases (one outlier at 0.85): a lone false memory with no imperative language does not look like prompt injection. Because full infection requires the propagation instruction, the classifier still blocks the component that makes the attack spread, but not goal infection on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 仅对注入的虚假信念进行评分（不包括指令块），在 5 个案例中有 4 个案例的得分在 0.02–0.09 之间（其中一个异常值为 0.85）：一个孤立且没有命令性语言的虚假记忆并不像提示注入。 由于完全感染需要传播指令，分类器仍然会阻止使攻击扩散的那个组件，但无法单独阻止目标感染本身。

paragraphs.en: Of 54 agent-written memories that the judge labelled clean, 14 are flagged, but all 14 contain the full injected payload. The judge labels authorship , i.e. whether the agent wrote the content during the current interaction, so payloads inherited from earlier memory state are labelled clean, whereas the classifier assesses content. On the remaining 40 there are no false positives. Authorship-based propagation labels therefore should not be reused directly as detector training labels.
paragraphs.zh: 在法官标记为干净的 54 条由智能体撰写的记忆中，有 14 条被标记为异常，但这 14 条均包含完整的注入负载。 法官会标注作者身份，即判断智能体是否在当前交互中撰写了内容，因此从早期记忆状态继承的负载会被标记为干净，而分类器则负责评估内容本身。 在其余 40 条记忆中，没有误报情况。 因此，基于作者身份的传播标签不应被直接用作检测器的训练标签。

paragraphs.en: The benign lists above contain no imperative language, so we also appended legitimate imperative entries to real seed lists, eight in each of three categories: the user’s own standing rules (“User asked me to always confirm the total before ordering”), assistant self-reminders (“Remember to verify crash-cart expiry every Monday”), and formatting preferences. The generic question flags all 24: it measures whether an entry is imperative rather than whether it is compromised. These scores overlap those of the subtler “team standard” template styles, so no single threshold separates the two.
paragraphs.zh: 上述良性列表不包含任何命令式语言，因此我们还向真实的种子列表追加了合法的命令式条目，每类各八个，共三类：用户自身的固定规则（“用户要求我在下单前始终确认总数”）、智能体自我提醒（“记得每周一下午核实紧急购物车的有效期”）以及格式偏好。 通用问题对这 24 条全部进行了标记：它衡量的是某条目是否为命令式，而非其是否被篡改。 这些得分与更细微的“团队标准”模板风格的得分存在重叠，因此没有单一阈值能将两者区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We reworded the question to ask whether instructions appear to come from an outside source rather than the user, for example by serving a third-party interest, invoking unstated authority, or asking to be copied onward, again without attack-specific wording. False positives on benign imperative memories fall from 24/24 to 4/24: all user rules and preferences now pass, and the remaining errors are data-handling checklists such as “archive chat logs weekly,” which are close to exfiltration instructions. Recall on the main template remains 1.000 (minimum score 0.96), 11 of 12 template styles are still caught, and seed lists remain free of false positives.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将问题重新表述，询问指令是否似乎来自外部来源而非用户，例如为第三方利益服务、援引未声明的权威，或要求被进一步复制，且同样避免使用与攻击相关的特定措辞。 对良性指令性记忆的误判率从 24/24 降至 4/24：所有用户规则和偏好现在都能通过，其余错误均为数据处理检查清单，例如“每周归档聊天记录”，这些与数据泄露指令较为接近。 主模板的召回率仍为 1.000（最低分数 0.96），12 种模板风格中有 11 种仍能被识别，且种子列表中未出现误判。

paragraphs.en: Screening memory writes is inexpensive and, against attacks that must store an explicit instruction to propagate, effective: asking whether a stored instruction originates from someone other than the user blocks the propagation instruction while passing nearly all of the user’s own rules. It does not remove false beliefs stored without instructions, and it does not address the artifacts that carry the attack between assistants, so it complements rather than replaces screening of shared artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 筛选内存写入操作成本低廉，并且对于必须存储明确指令才能传播的攻击而言十分有效：通过询问所存储的指令是否来自用户以外的人，既能阻止传播指令的执行，又能几乎同时保留用户自身的所有规则。 这种方法不会移除那些在没有指令的情况下存储的错误信念，也无法处理在智能体之间传递攻击的残留物，因此它是对共享残留物筛选机制的补充，而非替代。

paragraphs.en: Building on Section 2 , Table 10 compares the work most relevant to our attack on three different aspects: where the adversarial state persists, how it continues or reaches another agent, and how broadly the attack is evaluated. Later use of a poisoned memory by the same assistant is distinct from transmission to a second assistant.
paragraphs.zh: 基于第 2 节的内容，表 10 从三个方面比较了与我们攻击最相关的工作：对抗状态持续存在的位置、其如何延续或传递至另一个智能体，以及该攻击的评估范围有多广。 同一助手后续使用被污染的内存，与将其传输给第二个助手是不同的情况。

paragraphs.en: The closest parallels isolate different parts of this setting: Hidden in Memory evaluates a reusable template and persistence within one assistant; MURMUR examines effects across users of shared agent state; and the worm studies demonstrate transmission across agents through email, messages, or agent infrastructure. Here, transmission instead depends on successive user-requested document tasks across assistants with separate private memories.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的类比案例将这一设定中的不同部分进行了区分：《Hidden in Memory》评估了可重复使用的模板以及单个助手内部的持久性；《MURMUR》研究了共享智能体状态在不同用户之间的影响；而蠕虫研究则展示了通过电子邮件、消息或智能体基础设施在不同智能体之间进行传输的情况。 在此，传输则依赖于用户依次向具有独立私有记忆的多个助手发起文档处理任务。
